title: Business Development & Key Account Manager
description: About TACTILIA: At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup. This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible. You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor? The Role: As Business Development & Key Account Manager you will drive TACTILIA's commercial growth across selected industrial sectors, developing key customer relationships and turning market opportunities into business. Working closely with our leadership and product teams, you will execute the go-to-market strategy within your assigned industries and accounts. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role focused on developing new business, managing key accounts, leading customer discussions, preparing offers, negotiating deals and driving opportunities through to closure. You will act as the commercial interface between customers and internal teams, ensuring customer needs are translated into concrete business opportunities and actionable next steps. What you will do: Drive sales across assigned industries: Develop and grow customer relationships within selected verticals Own key customer accounts: Build trusted relationships with relevant stakeholders, from engineering and R&D leaders to business unit heads, management and procurement. Manage the full sales process: Take ownership from initial customer contact and opportunity qualification through discussions, product presentations, technical evaluations, quotations, negotiations and deal closure. Develop new business opportunities: Proactively identify potential customers, initiate conversations, build a strong pipeline and convert opportunities into concrete projects and commercial agreements. Lead customer discussions: Understand customer applications, challenges and requirements, and position TACTILIA's robotic hand as a relevant solution for their specific use cases. Drive commercial execution: Prepare and follow up on proposals, quotations and offers, coordinate internal resources and ensure that opportunities progress in a structured and timely manner. Coordinate technical and commercial discussions: Work closely with engineering, product management and leadership to align customer expectations with product capabilities, feasibility and development priorities. Represent TACTILIA externally: Build the company's presence within your industry through customer visits, industry events, trade fairs and relevant networks. Provide market and customer insights: Bring structured feedback on customer needs, competitive developments and industry trends back to the leadership and product teams to support strategic and product decisions. Build long-term partnerships: Develop relationships with OEMs, system integrators and other relevant industry players to establish TACTILIA as a trusted technology partner. What you bring: 5+ years of experience in B2B sales, key account management or business development, ideally within an industrial, automotive, defense, robotics or automation environment. A strong understanding of your respective industry, including its customer landscape, decision-making structures, commercial processes, and relevant stakeholders. A proven track record of developing customer relationships, managing complex sales cycles, and successfully closing commercial deals. Experience selling technically demanding products, industrial hardware or engineering solutions to established organizations. The ability to engage confidently with experienced technical and business stakeholders, understand their challenges, and turn discussions into concrete commercial opportunities. Strong negotiation, presentation, and communication skills, combined with a pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset. A structured and hands-on approach to sales execution, including pipeline management, opportunity tracking, proposal preparation and consistent follow-up. The ability to work cross-functionally with product, engineering and management teams in a fast-moving startup environment. A high level of ownership, persistence and commercial drive. You know how to move things forward and get deals done. Fluent German and English, both written and spoken. Bonus: Familiarity with robotics, Physical AI, humanoids or dexterous manipulation. Experience in a startup or scale-up environment, ideally within a technically complex product organization. The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world. At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale. The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI. Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next. If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that works reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Product Manager, Platform (all genders)
description: Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com. We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by four leading VCs (TQ Ventures, Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80 m Series C, we are ready to push beyond. The Opportunity As a Product Manager in the Platform team, you own our established booking API, used by all our clients for booking and post-sales actions. You extend its functionality to match the market, build new capabilities on top of our wealth of data, and make the API as easy as possible to use and understand, so new clients can get started faster.  What you will do: Product Ownership & Strategy: Own the product end-to-end, shaping its roadmap and priorities for booking and post-sales functionality, and working autonomously within the team’s direction. API Evolution: Extend booking and post-sales capabilities to match market standards, and build new features on top of our established API. Integration Experience: Make the API simple to understand and use, with clear contracts, documentation, and flows that shorten onboarding for new customers. Complex Solution Design: Design end-to-end solutions across multiple systems and workflows, working with engineering on system design for high-load environments. Quality & Reliability: Make sure the product is robust and error-resistant, with every relevant use case and edge case covered. Data-Driven Initiatives: Use our booking data and research to find opportunities, shape strategic initiatives, and measure impact. Stakeholder Alignment: Align retailers, carriers, engineering, commercial, and operations teams around clear priorities and outcomes. Workplace: We are mainly looking for this role to be based within Germany, preferably in our HQ in Berlin. We are a remote-first company, with teams located around the Globe and our HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office. Who you are: 2+ years of product management experience, with a strong focus on B2B and technical products. Hands-on AI experience and the ambition to make it core to how you work, shipping faster without compromising quality. Proven experience owning API products end-to-end, from contract design to customer adoption. Solid understanding of system design and high-load, transactional systems; able to discuss architecture trade-offs with engineers. A track record of independently leading complex product initiatives with multiple stakeholders. Strong attention to detail and design thinking, especially for complex workflows and edge cases. A data-driven, impact-focused mindset, using data and research to shape decisions. Excellent communication skills in English. Nice to Have Experience with ticket-selling, booking, or auction systems. Background in travel, mobility, or marketplace platforms. What you can expect: You will join a fast-paced travel tech company and take on a rapidly growing industry. You will take on ownership and responsibility from day one and have a direct impact on the success of the company. We value agility! We’re constantly updating our tech stack and offer the best possible tools to ensure all of our in-house engineers, partners, and carriers benefit from cutting-edge, efficient solutions. You will work with global companies. Our product attracts the biggest names in travel technology, such as Booking.com, Google Maps, and national carriers like Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF. For Management positions: As part of the management team, you will shape our strategy and organization beyond your area of responsibility. You will join an international team of talented, driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day! We offer flexible and remote working conditions, relocation opportunities, and career growth in a small and developing company. raw.description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by four leading VCs (TQ Ventures, Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80 m Series C, we are ready to push beyond.

The Opportunity

As a Product Manager in the Platform team, you own our established booking API, used by all our clients for booking and post-sales actions. You extend its functionality to match the market, build new capabilities on top of our wealth of data, and make the API as easy as possible to use and understand, so new clients can get started faster. 

What you will do:

  • Product Ownership & Strategy: Own the product end-to-end, shaping its roadmap and priorities for booking and post-sales functionality, and working autonomously within the team’s direction.

  • API Evolution: Extend booking and post-sales capabilities to match market standards, and build new features on top of our established API.

  • Integration Experience: Make the API simple to understand and use, with clear contracts, documentation, and flows that shorten onboarding for new customers.

  • Complex Solution Design: Design end-to-end solutions across multiple systems and workflows, working with engineering on system design for high-load environments.

  • Quality & Reliability: Make sure the product is robust and error-resistant, with every relevant use case and edge case covered.

  • Data-Driven Initiatives: Use our booking data and research to find opportunities, shape strategic initiatives, and measure impact.

  • Stakeholder Alignment: Align retailers, carriers, engineering, commercial, and operations teams around clear priorities and outcomes.

Workplace:

We are mainly looking for this role to be based within Germany, preferably in our HQ in Berlin.

We are a remote-first company, with teams located around the Globe and our HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office.


Who you are:

  • 2+ years of product management experience, with a strong focus on B2B and technical products.

  • Hands-on AI experience and the ambition to make it core to how you work, shipping faster without compromising quality.

  • Proven experience owning API products end-to-end, from contract design to customer adoption.

  • Solid understanding of system design and high-load, transactional systems; able to discuss architecture trade-offs with engineers.

  • A track record of independently leading complex product initiatives with multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong attention to detail and design thinking, especially for complex workflows and edge cases.

  • A data-driven, impact-focused mindset, using data and research to shape decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills in English.

    Nice to Have

  • Experience with ticket-selling, booking, or auction systems.

  • Background in travel, mobility, or marketplace platforms.


What you can expect:

  • You will join a fast-paced travel tech company and take on a rapidly growing industry.

  • You will take on ownership and responsibility from day one and have a direct impact on the success of the company.

  • We value agility! We’re constantly updating our tech stack and offer the best possible tools to ensure all of our in-house engineers, partners, and carriers benefit from cutting-edge, efficient solutions.

  • You will work with global companies. Our product attracts the biggest names in travel technology, such as Booking.com, Google Maps, and national carriers like Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.

  • For Management positions: As part of the management team, you will shape our strategy and organization beyond your area of responsibility.

  • You will join an international team of talented, driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!

  • We offer flexible and remote working conditions, relocation opportunities, and career growth in a small and developing company.


Our hiring process for this role:

Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Anh Do and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Jorien Knipping.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer - Ceph / On-Prem Cloud Storage (m/f/d)
description: Your Role You will help us build, operate and industrialize the storage foundation of our on-premise cloud platform. As part of a small, experienced team, you will own the Ceph clusters behind our block, object and file storage services – essentially the storage every customer workload eventually lands on. The platform is still actively being built, which means you will have real influence on the storage architecture, hardware lifecycle, automation strategy and technical direction. The role goes beyond Ceph itself: you will regularly work across bare metal, networking, OpenStack, Kubernetes and GitOps. As a Senior Engineer, you take ownership of your area and help make storage predictable, durable and highly automated as we scale into the petabytes Unser Tech Stack 🚀 · Ceph · OpenStack · Kubernetes · KVM · Linux · Bare Metal · Ansible · Terraform · Go · Cinder ·Neutron · Nova · RBD · Cilium · RGW/ S3 · Prometheus/ Grafana · FluxCD / ArgoCD · Git· Python · Claude Code · Cursor · Agentic Coding Tooling Your Responsibilities Design, operate and evolve our Ceph clusters for block, object / S3 and file storage - from CRUSH topology and failure domains to pool design, placement groups, erasure coding, capacity headroom and performance. Own the storage hardware lifecycle end to end – from qualification and burn-in through firmware, controller and disk health to OSD add/drain/replace, node retirement and hardware refresh. A key part of the job is automating these processes without creating tenant-visible impact. Automate the provisioning of storage nodes on OpenStack-managed bare metal , working with Ironic, RAID and disk configuration, SEDs, provider networks and VLANs. You will also own the artefact path around images, package mirrors, certificates and other dependencies needed to bring up clusters in environments with tightly controlled external connectivity. Run upgrades, rebalancing and reconfigurations as routine production operations, evolve our Infrastructure as Code and GitOps setup with Ansible, Terraform and FluxCD / ArgoCD, and make sure storage integrates cleanly with both OpenStack and Kubernetes. Own capacity planning and growth forecasting , use telemetry to understand real consumption, and build out monitoring, testing and failure-injection around performance, durability and security. AI-assisted engineering is simply part of how we work today. You use LLMs and agentic tools where they genuinely help – across development, testing, reviews, incident triage, knowledge retrieval or automation - and help us push further into self-healing and auto-remediation. Act as a technical reference and sparring partner across Ceph, storage, automation and AI tooling , document technical decisions and share your knowledge with the team. What we offer Exceptional team spirit across all departments and national borders; we live #OneTeam Exciting work in a highly innovative and international environment with cutting-edge technologies 32 vacation days, increasing with length of service Flexible working hours, home office options, and a secure permanent position with market- and performance-based compensation Employer-funded pension plan and an attractive insurance package OVHcloud covers 50% of public transportation costs Up to €400 annual financial contribution from OVHcloud towards sports activities (gym membership, sports classes, etc.) Through Corporate Benefits, you receive attractive discounts at numerous shops and companies We contribute to the leasing of your cargo bike Regular company events and free cold and hot beverages Several years of hands-on experience as an SRE, Storage Engineer or Platform Engineer running production storage infrastructure, with solid experience deploying, operating and debugging Ceph in production. You know the Ceph fundamentals from real-world operations: CRUSH, pools and placement groups, replication vs. erasure coding, BlueStore, scrubbing, recovery and backfill under load . You have managed storage infrastructure end to end , from the physical layer with drives, firmware, BIOS, controllers and hardware diagnostics through rebalancing, host drains, capacity expansion and hardware generation migrations. You are comfortable using Kubernetes as a control plane , not only as a workload runtime, and understand operators/controllers, custom resources, reconciliation and GitOps. You can also move confidently around OpenStack and debug issues involving Ironic, Neutron, Nova or Glance when needed. You have dealt with situations where durability really matters – such as degraded or near-full clusters, recovery under load or split-brain conditions – and you are used to making changes in a staged, evidence-based and reversible way. You have strong Linux and bare-metal skills , understand the block layer, filesystems and I/O behaviour, and are comfortable working with Ansible, Terraform and GitOps . AI-assisted engineering is already part of your day-to-day work. You have practical experience with LLMs and agentic tools and know where they can meaningfully support development, testing, reviews or operations. Ideally, you also bring experience with RGW / S3, RBD mirroring, CephFS or ceph-csi , deeper OpenStack storage integrations and Go and/or Python. Experience around VLAN/BGP, storage performance tuning, NVMe/BlueStore, observability, data protection, encryption, auto-remediation, security baselines or multi-site storage is also relevant for the role. You work autonomously, bring a strong sense of ownership , and are comfortable debugging problems where the actual root cause may sit somewhere between storage, networking, Kubernetes and OpenStack. You would rather verify what is happening from evidence than assume how the system should behave. We work in an international environment in English , so you should feel comfortable discussing technical topics, documenting decisions and working with the team in English. title: Werkstudent Vertriebsunterstützung (m/w/d)
description: Mut ist unser Antrieb, Zusammenhalt ist unsere Stärke. Seit über 160 Jahren begleiten wir Menschen zuverlässig durchs Leben – mit einem innovativen Portfolio an Versicherungs- und Vorsorgeprodukten. Als Versicherungsverein auf Gegenseitigkeit gestalten wir gemeinsam mit mehr als 600 Mitarbeitenden die Zukunft der Versicherung neu und legen dabei besonderen Wert auf soziale und ökologische Verantwortung. Unsere Mitarbeitenden sind das Herzstück unseres Erfolgs. Wir leben eine offene, vertrauensvolle Unternehmenskultur und heißen Menschen jeden Alters, jeder Herkunft und Lebensweise willkommen, die gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft gestalten wollen. Kurz zusammengefasst – das erwartet dich Das VertriebsPartnerCenter (VPC) ist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für unsere Vertriebspartner bei fachlichen und prozessualen Fragen rund um die Zusammenarbeit mit der Bayerischen. Unser Ziel ist es, eine effiziente und serviceorientierte Unterstützung sicherzustellen, Vertriebsaktivitäten zu fördern und unsere Prozesse kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Je nach Interesse und aktuellem Bedarf kannst du als Werkstudent (m/w/d) Einblicke in unterschiedliche Themenfelder gewinnen und dort aktiv mitarbeiten – von Social Media und digitalen Vertriebsmaßnahmen über die Organisation von Webinaren bis hin zur Datenpflege, Excel-Auswertungen, Partneranbindungen und vertriebsnahen Administrationsprozessen. Deine zukünftigen Aufgaben  Du unterstützt unser Team bei der Bearbeitung von Anfragen unserer Vertriebspartner und internen Vertriebseinheiten zu Prozessen, Systemen und organisatorischen Themen. Eigenständig recherchierst du Informationen, bereitest Auswertungen und Präsentationen auf und unterstützt bei vertriebsrelevanten Projekten und Kampagnen. Gemeinsam mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen arbeitest du an der Koordination und Umsetzung vertrieblicher sowie organisatorischer Maßnahmen. Mit deinen Ideen wirkst du an der Analyse, Optimierung und Digitalisierung von Prozessen und Arbeitsabläufen mit. Darüber hinaus übernimmst du administrative Aufgaben, pflegst Dokumentationen und unterstützt im Tagesgeschäft.   Das bringst du mit Du bist noch für mindestens zwei Semester immatrikuliert, idealerweise in einem wirtschaftsnahen Studiengang. Viel wichtiger als dein konkretes Studienfach sind jedoch dein Interesse an vertriebsnahen Themen, deine Lernbereitschaft und die Motivation, dich in neue Aufgabenfelder einzuarbeiten. Eine strukturierte, zuverlässige und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise zeichnet dich aus. Auch bei mehreren parallelen Aufgaben behältst du den Überblick. Du kommunizierst freundlich, professionell und serviceorientiert mit verschiedenen Ansprechpartnern und hast Freude am Austausch mit Menschen. Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mindestens C2-Niveau) sowie ein sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft Office, insbesondere Excel, Outlook und PowerPoint, gehören zu deinem Profil. Interesse an Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und KI-Technologien sowie die Motivation, Prozesse aktiv weiterzuentwickeln, runden dein Profil ab. Neugierig geworden? Dann melde dich gerne direkt bei unserem Recruiter Michael (-2126). Wir freuen uns auf Dein Interesse ! description: Als erste dedizierte DevOps-Person im Team entscheidest du von Anfang an mit, wie der moderne DevOps Betrieb im KI-Zeitalter gestaltet wird. Für ein international führendes Publishing-Tech-Unternehmen suchen wir einen DevOps Engineer, der klassisches DevOps-Know-how mit KI und Automatisierung verbindet - überall dort, wo es möglich und sinnvoll ist. Das Unternehmen ... ... hinter dieser Stelle bringt seit über 15 Jahren Bücher in die digitale Welt. Auf einer selbst entwickelten Cloud-Plattform verwalten mehrere tausend Verlage ihre E-Books, Hörbücher und Podcasts und bringen sie von dort in alle relevanten Shops, Streaming- und Abo-Dienste weltweit. Die Company ist in den letzten Jahren stark gewachsen, wird von einem der großen internationalen Software-Investoren unterstützt und beschäftigt ca. 230 Menschen an Standorten in Europa sowie Nord- und Südamerika. Das Herz der Software-Entwicklung schlägt in Dortmund. KI ist hier kein Buzzword, sondern Geschäftsfeld: Von KI-vertonten Hörbüchern über die Lizenzierung von Verlagsinhalten an KI-Unternehmen bis zur besseren Auffindbarkeit von Inhalten. Derzeit werden auch neue KI-basierte Funktionen und -Services für die Nutzer der Plattform entwickelt. Der aktuelle Tech-Stack Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate/JPA, PostgreSQL, TypeScript/React, Python, AWS, Docker, Jenkins, Linux, Claude Code, Open Code. Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest Aufbau, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung der CI/CD-Pipelines sowie der Cloud- und Container-Infrastruktur auf AWS. Du integrierst KI-gestützte Tools in den Betrieb für Monitoring, Anomalie-Erkennung, Incident-Response und Kapazitätsplanung. Du übersetzt betriebliche Anforderungen in Automatisierungs-Skripte, Infrastructure-as-Code und Prompts für KI-Systeme und verantwortest die Qualität der Ergebnisse. Du analysierst System- und Log-Daten mit KI-Unterstützung, erkennst Probleme früh und reduzierst Ausfallzeiten. Du sorgst für Sicherheit, Skalierbarkeit und Wartbarkeit mit Hardening, Security-Reviews und automatisierten Compliance-Checks. Du bist Ansprechpartner:in für alle DevOps-Themen im Team, setzt Standards und gibst dein Wissen an die Entwickler:innen weiter. Du behältst neue Tools und Ansätze im Blick und entscheidest mit, was den Betrieb wirklich voranbringt. Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD) und mit Monitoring, Logging und Alerting produktiver Systeme (z. B. Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog) Konkrete Erfahrung mit KI und Automatisierung im DevOps-Betrieb , etwa KI-gestützte Log-Analyse, AIOps-Funktionen, KI-Assistenten für Infrastructure-as-Code oder selbst gebaute Automatisierungen mit LLMs Ausgeprägtes Sicherheitsbewusstsein (Secure Infrastructure, OWASP, Zero Trust) und gutes Verständnis von Netzwerksicherheit und System-Härtung Eigeninitiative und Lust, als erste dedizierte DevOps-Person Strukturen aufzubauen und andere mitzunehmen Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort & Schrift (C1) und gutes Englisch Worauf du dich freuen kannst ... Ein attraktives Gehalt, abhängig von deiner Erfahrung in DevOps und KI-Nutzung dafür Hybrides Arbeiten mit einem Team, das vor Ort in Dortmund sitzt (2 Tage/Woche remote) Eine Rolle mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst, wie hier künftig DevOps betrieben wird Zugang zu aktuellen KI-Coding-Tools und die Freiheit, Neues auszuprobieren Ein Produkt mit Sinn: Bücher und Wissen in vielen Sprachen und Formaten zugänglich machen Internationales Umfeld mit kurzen Wegen Eine langfristige Perspektive in einem wachsenden Unternehmen Umfangreiche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, um dich up-to-date zu halten Regelmäßige Team-Events Betriebliche Altersvorsorge Weitere Corporate Benefits Mitarbeiter-Rabatte Eine JobRad Leasing-Option Klingt das interessant & passend für dich? description: adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile app growth and monetization, challenging the status quo of adtech by redefining how apps acquire users and generate revenue. Our two products, Playtime Arcade and adjoe Ads, sit at opposite ends of the mobile advertising spectrum: rewarded engagement and programmatic in-app advertising. Together they run on 13% of the world’s smartphones , connecting advertisers, publishers, and hundreds of millions of users, with one goal: making mobile advertising work better for everyone in the ecosystem. Next-Gen Machine Intelligence for Auctions & Real-Time Bidding The Data Science Research team builds the foundational algorithms that govern real-time bidding, budget pacing, and allocation mechanics across our products. Operating as a horizontal deep-tech layer, the team leverages advanced AI—specifically reinforcement learning, objective-based optimization, and control theory—to deliver critical systems that perfectly harmonize advertiser ROI, platform health, and user relevance. These frameworks scale adjoe’s products beyond standard industry limitations, utilizing behavioral and transactional data from over 770 million users . The team operates at the intersection of high-load, low-latency engineering, auction mechanism design, and state-of-the-art machine learning . Acting as the company’s internal science bar raiser, they translate complex business constraints into mathematical objectives. The full lifecycle of these AI capabilities is owned by the team—from academic paper translation and offline prototyping to deploying core algorithmic frameworks built to sustain ultra-low latency, real-time production environments evaluating tens of thousands of requests per second. You have a PhD in CS, Statistics, Math, or Physics (or an MSc with extensive industry research) and a track record of peer-reviewed publications in fields like Computational Advertising, Auction Theory, Mechanism Design, or Game Theory. You’ve spent 4+ years optimizing complex systems through automated algorithms in AdTech, marketplaces, or high-frequency trading. You translate research into production, not just prototypes. You distill SOTA research into robust, production-ready code optimized for sub-millisecond latency. At adjoe, that means architecting sophisticated auction mechanics, real-time bidding engines, and allocation algorithms serving millions of requests across a stack built on 770 million users. Deep expertise in Reinforcement Learning and Optimization. You have hands-on, deep theoretical and technical expertise in objective-based optimization, control theory, or RL applied specifically to bidding, pricing strategy, and budget pacing under extreme production constraints. You lead architectural debates, collaborate tightly with Product Managers and Engineers to map business goals to mathematical objective functions, mentor junior scientists, and drive the team’s research direction without needing a roadmap handed to you. 🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team. What’s in It for You? At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum. Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams. Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other. Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy. title: Product Manager, Platform (all genders)
description: Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com. We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by four leading VCs (TQ Ventures, Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80 m Series C, we are ready to push beyond. The Opportunity As a Product Manager in the Platform team, you own our established booking API, used by all our clients for booking and post-sales actions. You extend its functionality to match the market, build new capabilities on top of our wealth of data, and make the API as easy as possible to use and understand, so new clients can get started faster. What you will do: Product Ownership & Strategy: Own the product end-to-end, shaping its roadmap and priorities for booking and post-sales functionality, and working autonomously within the team’s direction. API Evolution: Extend booking and post-sales capabilities to match market standards, and build new features on top of our established API. Integration Experience: Make the API simple to understand and use, with clear contracts, documentation, and flows that shorten onboarding for new customers. Complex Solution Design: Design end-to-end solutions across multiple systems and workflows, working with engineering on system design for high-load environments. Quality & Reliability: Make sure the product is robust and error-resistant, with every relevant use case and edge case covered. Data-Driven Initiatives: Use our booking data and research to find opportunities, shape strategic initiatives, and measure impact. Stakeholder Alignment: Align retailers, carriers, engineering, commercial, and operations teams around clear priorities and outcomes. Workplace: We are mainly looking for this role to be based within Germany, preferably in our HQ in Berlin. We are a remote-first company, with teams located around the Globe and our HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office. Who you are: 2+ years of product management experience, with a strong focus on B2B and technical products. Hands-on AI experience and the ambition to make it core to how you work, shipping faster without compromising quality. Proven experience owning API products end-to-end, from contract design to customer adoption. Solid understanding of system design and high-load, transactional systems; able to discuss architecture trade-offs with engineers. A track record of independently leading complex product initiatives with multiple stakeholders. Strong attention to detail and design thinking, especially for complex workflows and edge cases. A data-driven, impact-focused mindset, using data and research to shape decisions. Excellent communication skills in English. Nice to Have Experience with ticket-selling, booking, or auction systems. Background in travel, mobility, or marketplace platforms. What you can expect: You will join a fast-paced travel tech company and take on a rapidly growing industry. You will take on ownership and responsibility from day one and have a direct impact on the success of the company. We value agility! We’re constantly updating our tech stack and offer the best possible tools to ensure all of our in-house engineers, partners, and carriers benefit from cutting-edge, efficient solutions. You will work with global companies. Our product attracts the biggest names in travel technology, such as Booking.com, Google Maps, and national carriers like Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF. For Management positions: As part of the management team, you will shape our strategy and organization beyond your area of responsibility. You will join an international team of talented, driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day! We offer flexible and remote working conditions, relocation opportunities, and career growth in a small and developing company. title: Fertigungstechniker / Industrial Engineering (m/w/d)
description: Wir bauen etwas auf. Gestalte mit. Bei surge aero GmbH entwickeln und bauen wir Antriebssysteme für unbemannte Luftfahrzeuge. In Heimstetten bei München entsteht unsere neue Motorenproduktion – mit komplett neuem Equipment, einem motivierten Team und großen Plänen. Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die Technik verstehen, gerne praktisch arbeiten und Lust haben, eine moderne Produktion von Anfang an mitzugestalten. Als Fertigungstechniker unterstützt du uns dabei, aus unserer neuen Motorenmontage eine zuverlässige und effiziente Serienproduktion zu entwickeln. Du verbesserst Montageabläufe, unterstützt bei der Entwicklung und Einführung neuer Werkzeuge und Vorrichtungen und sorgst gemeinsam mit unserem Team dafür, dass unsere Fertigungsprozesse mit steigenden Stückzahlen immer besser werden. Dabei arbeitest du nicht nur am Schreibtisch, sondern bist direkt in unserer Fertigung unterwegs. Du probierst Dinge aus, erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und setzt praktische Lösungen gemeinsam mit unseren Technikern und Monteuren um. Darauf kannst du dich freuen Eine Produktion, die du mitgestalten kannst: Neue Montageausrüstung, moderne Werkzeuge und viel Raum für eigene Ideen und Verbesserungen. Viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Du übernimmst Verantwortung und kannst deine praktische Erfahrung direkt in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Fertigung einbringen. Spannende Technik: Du arbeitest an der Industrialisierung kompakter Hochleistungsmotoren für unbemannte Luftfahrzeuge. Keine Nachtschicht: Deine Nächte bleiben frei. Ein motiviertes Team: Du arbeitest mit Kollegen zusammen, die Begeisterung für Technik haben und gemeinsam etwas aufbauen wollen. Die Chance, mit uns zu wachsen: Mit steigenden Stückzahlen entwickeln wir unsere Produktion weiter – und du bist von Anfang an dabei. Eine langfristige Perspektive: Wir bieten dir einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag in einem wachsenden Unternehmen. Das machst du bei uns Du analysierst unsere Montageabläufe und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Kollegen praktische Verbesserungen für eine sichere, einfache und effiziente Fertigung. Du unterstützt bei der Auswahl, Entwicklung und Erprobung zusätzlicher Werkzeuge, Montagevorrichtungen und Hilfsmittel und begleitest deren Einführung in die Produktion. Du erstellst und optimierst verständliche Arbeitsanweisungen, Montageabläufe und Arbeitspläne. Du ermittelst Montagezeiten, erkennst Engpässe und hilfst dabei, unsere Produktivität und Qualität kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Du begleitest unseren Produktionsanlauf direkt vor Ort, unterstützt bei technischen Problemen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Motorentechnikern passende Lösungen. Du arbeitest eng mit Entwicklung und Qualitätssicherung zusammen, um Produktänderungen und technische Verbesserungen in unsere Montageprozesse zu übernehmen. Du unterstützt die Verbesserung unserer Materialbereitstellung und Fertigungsabläufe und hilfst dabei, unsere Produktion auf steigende Stückzahlen vorzubereiten. Das bringst du mit Du hast Freude an Technik, verstehst mechanische Zusammenhänge und weißt aus eigener Erfahrung, worauf es in einer Fertigung ankommt. Du denkst praktisch, arbeitest selbstständig und findest gerne Lösungen, die nicht nur auf dem Papier, sondern auch am Montagearbeitsplatz funktionieren. Du hast eine abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung, idealerweise ergänzt durch eine Weiterbildung zum Techniker oder Meister, und bringst mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Montage, Fertigung, Arbeitsvorbereitung oder Industrialisierung mit. Besonders freuen wir uns, wenn du selbst einmal in einer Montage oder Werkstatt gearbeitet und anschließend Verantwortung für die Verbesserung von Fertigungsabläufen übernommen hast. Du kannst technische Zeichnungen und Stücklisten lesen, kennst dich mit Montageprozessen und Werkzeugen aus und hast idealerweise bereits bei der Entwicklung oder Einführung von Montagevorrichtungen mitgewirkt. Du arbeitest gerne mit anderen zusammen, kannst dich mit Entwicklern ebenso gut austauschen wie mit Monteuren und hast keine Scheu, selbst zum Werkzeug zu greifen. Auf Deutsch kannst du dich sicher verständigen und technische Unterlagen bearbeiten. Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil. Wichtiger als dein Abschluss sind uns deine praktische Erfahrung, dein technisches Verständnis und deine Fähigkeit, Verbesserungen selbstständig anzupacken und umzusetzen. Komm ins Team. title: Senior Product Manager (Enterprise)
description: The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact. Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve: Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register . We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us. Your main goal will be to empower n8n enterprise users to treat automation as software, enabling them to develop, deploy, and scale mission-critical workflows with absolute confidence. To do so, you’ll own product strategy and execution for n8n’s Enterprise team, focused on application lifecycle management, developer tools, and production-grade workflow operations: WORKFLOW LIFECYCLE MANAGEMENT Define how teams move workflows from development to production with clear environment separation and promotion paths. Shape capabilities for workflow version history, rollback, branching, and conflict resolution. Build product experiences that help engineering teams safely manage changes across mission-critical automations. ENTERPRISE DEVELOPER EXPERIENCE Own Git-based source control workflows that make n8n fit naturally into modern software development practices. Work closely with Engineering and Design to deliver powerful yet intuitive tools for technical teams. Translate complex developer workflows into product experiences that feel reliable, scalable, and easy to adopt. PRODUCTION OPERATIONS AND OBSERVABILITY Build visibility into workflow performance, usage, and reliability across environments and instances. Define how enterprise teams manage external secrets, variables, and configuration across deployments. Help customers operate n8n at scale through multi-instance management and cross-instance visibility. PRODUCT DISCOVERY AND CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP Deeply engage with enterprise customers, engineering leaders, admins, and developers to understand their software delivery needs. Prioritize ruthlessly across technical depth, usability, enterprise readiness, and long-term platform leverage. Align Engineering, Design, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and leadership through clear strategy, specs, and communication. Exceptional product sense: You anticipate edge cases, second-order effects, and enterprise-grade reliability needs without needing perfect information. Ownership and bias for action: You fix what’s broken, ship, learn, and iterate rather than over-plan. Influence without authority: You align engineering, design, data, sales, solutions engineering, customer success, and docs through clarity and trust. Technical product judgment: You’re comfortable making tradeoffs across usability, scalability, security, reliability, and implementation complexity. Observability experience: You’ve worked on products involving monitoring, usage insights, performance visibility, or operational dashboards. Coding or SQL skills: You can code, write SQL, or go deep enough technically to partner effectively with engineers on architecture-level discussions. Remote work experience: You’re familiar with remote-first work environments and can collaborate effectively across time zones. Entrepreneurial or early-stage experience: You’ve worn many hats and can navigate in many areas at once. Why join us? At n8n, your work won’t disappear into a slide deck. You’ll shape how engineering teams build, version, deploy, and operate mission-critical automations at scale — turning n8n into the platform where automation is treated with the same rigor as software. You’ll join a fast-growing, remote-first team with high autonomy, strong technical ambition, and direct visibility into enterprise customer impact. Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on? Wir digitalisieren Bargeld und Zahlungsprozesse in der Kinder und Jugendhilfe, der Eingliederungshilfe und der Altenhilfe und entlasten die Mitarbeitenden von Verwaltungsaufwand. Dafür suchen wir eine echte Allrounderin oder einen echten Allrounder: Heute organisierst du einen Messestand, morgen schreibst du eine Pressemitteilung und übermorgen baust du mit Sales eine Emailkampagne. Genau diese Vielseitigkeit braucht ein schnell wachsendes Startup wie wir. Du planst, organisierst und betreust unsere Messeauftritte und Veranstaltungen, vom Standaufbau über Teamplanung und Hotels bis zum Auftritt vor Ort. Im engen Sparring mit unserem Sales Team setzt du Emailsequenzen und Kampagnen um, zum Beispiel Einladungen vor Messen, Follow ups danach und unseren Newsletter. Das bringst Du mit Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Eventmanagement, Marketing oder Kommunikation gesammelt, idealerweise im B2B Umfeld, und hast bereits Messen oder Fachveranstaltungen von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung verantwortet. Du schreibst sicher und gerne auf Deutsch, von der Einladung über die Emailsequenz bis zur Pressemitteilung, und hast Erfahrung mit Emailkampagnen und einem CRM, idealerweise Pipedrive. Du arbeitest strukturiert und selbstständig, behältst auch bei mehreren Projekten gleichzeitig den Überblick und reist gern zu Messen in ganz Deutschland. description: Wir sind Impuls Energy Trading – ein junges, profitabel wachsendes Stromhandelsunternehmen mit Fokus auf erneuerbare Energien. Wenn du aus dem Leistungssport, vom Pokertisch, aus kompetitivem Gaming, dem Finanzhandel oder einem anderen Umfeld kommst, in dem Fokus, Timing und gute Entscheidungen unter Druck zählen, kannst du sehr gut zu uns passen. Aufgaben Du handelst aktiv und manuell an den Spotmärkten (Day ahead und Intraday) – mit direktem Bezug zu unserem Erzeugungsportfolio und auch proprietär. Du arbeitest im strukturierten Zwei-Schicht-System (Früh-/Spätschicht, keine Nachtschichten), dafür volle Präsenz zu den entscheidenden Marktzeiten. Du teilst relevante Marktbeobachtungen schnell und klar im Team, sorgst für saubere Übergaben und trägst dazu bei, dass wir als Trading-Desk gemeinsam besser werden. Du behältst unter Druck einen klaren Kopf : ohne Angst, ohne Gier, und ohne dich aus der Ruhe bringen zu lassen, wenn eine Entscheidung einmal gegen dich läuft. Du bringst echten, nachweisbaren Wettbewerbsgeist mit – idealerweise sichtbar in deinem Werdegang (z. B. Leistungssport, Poker, kompetitives Gaming, Wettbewerbe oder andere Felder, in denen Leistung zählt). Eine gewisse „positive Verrücktheit“ und die Fähigkeit richtig tief in eine Sache abtauchen zu können sind in diesem Markt ein entscheidender Vorteil. Du arbeitest eigenständig und verlässlich , übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst deine Ideen aktiv ins Team ein. Du bist kompetitiv, aber nicht ego-getrieben: Du willst gewinnen, teilst Informationen offen, gibst und nimmst Feedback und stellst die Qualität des Teams über den einzelnen Trade. Analytisches Denken, Mustererkennung und ein Gespür für Details gehören zu deinen Stärken. Ein quantitatives Studium (z. B. Mathematik, Physik, Informatik, Ingenieurwesen oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften) ist von Vorteil. Noch wichtiger ist uns aber der richtige Kopf – auch starke Quereinsteiger mit einem ansonsten starken Lebenslauf sind ausdrücklich willkommen. title: Filialleiter / Stellvertretender Filialleiter (m/w/d)
description: Mitfahren kann jeder. Du willst vorne fahren? Dann übernimm bei uns eine Filiale. Du führst deine Crew aus bis zu 8 Leuten und kümmerst dich um über 3.000 Artikel. Dazu kommen jede Menge Kunden, die mit dem richtigen Rad nach Hause rollen wollen. Ob du leitest oder erstmal stellvertrittst, finden wir zusammen raus. Über uns Wir sind Little John Bikes. Bei uns dreht sich alles ums Rad, vom Stadtflitzer bis zum E-Bike. Wir sind bodenständig, reden Klartext und lachen gern. Und unsere Branche nimmt gerade richtig Fahrt auf. Was du von uns bekommst Geld, das sich lohnt: hohes Grundgehalt plus Ertragsprovision für deine Leistung und die deiner Crew. Unbefristeter Vertrag. Punkt. 30 Tage Urlaub , ab 55 sogar 32. Weihnachten und Silvester frei. Jedes Jahr. Arbeitszeitkonto: Im Sommer gibst du Gas, im Winter nimmst du dir die Zeit zurück. Über das Jahr passt's. Einarbeitung in einer Patenfiliale. Keiner schmeißt dich ins kalte Wasser. Dein Weg zum Meister: Du bist Zweiradmechatroniker-Geselle? Wir fördern dich bis zum Zweiradmechanikermeister. Weiterbildung und Persönlichkeitsentwicklung , damit du als Führungskraft wächst. Echte Perspektive: von der Stellvertretung zur Filialleitung. Und darüber hinaus. 30 % Rabatt für dich, das ganze Jahr. Dienstrad-Leasing. Wär ja auch komisch, wenn nicht. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Empfehlungsprämie: Du holst gute Leute in die Crew, wir sagen Danke. Produkte, die Spaß machen: E-Bikes und hochwertige Räder in einer Branche mit Zukunft. Was du bei uns bewegst Leitung oder Stellvertretung? Das klären wir im Gespräch. Du leitest schon eine Filiale? Top. Du warst bisher Stellvertretung oder erfahrener Verkäufer und willst den nächsten Schritt machen? Auch top. Entweder übernimmst du direkt die Leitung, oder du startest als Stellvertretung und wächst rein. Du führst und motivierst deine Crew aus bis zu 8 Mitarbeitern. Als Filialleitung trägst du die Verantwortung. Als Stellvertretung unterstützt du und springst ein. Du planst die Abläufe, von der Sortimentspflege bis zum Einsatzplan. Du hältst über 3.000 Artikel in Schuss. Du stehst selbst auf der Fläche, berätst Kunden und machst den Deal klar. Du hast die Zahlen im Blick und bringst deine Filiale nach vorn. Du bist da, wenn's mal hakt. Für deine Crew und für die Kunden. Was du mitbringst Must-haves Erfahrung im Einzelhandel. Führungserfahrung als Filialleitung oder Stellvertretung. Oder richtig Lust auf deinen ersten Schritt in die Führung. Du behältst den Überblick. Auch im Juli, wenn der Laden brummt. Du redest gern mit Menschen und bringst den Abschluss sicher nach Hause. Du denkst unternehmerisch und steckst andere mit deiner Energie an. Empathie und eine gesunde Portion Humor. Muss ja. Flexibilität in der Saison. Nice-to-haves Handelserfahrung aus Fahrrad, Auto, Möbel, Mode oder Schuhe. Fahrradwissen. Hilft, ist aber kein Muss. Werkstatt-Background als Zweiradmechatroniker-Geselle. Einige unserer Filialleiter haben genau so angefangen und machen bei uns ihren Meister. Klingt nach deinem Ding? Dann schnapp dir den Lenker und bewirb dich. Kein Anschreiben, kein Bewerbungs-Blabla. Dein Lebenslauf reicht. Diese Stelle passt auch, wenn du dich als Filialleiter, stellvertretender Filialleiter, Storemanager, stellvertretender Storemanager, Leiter einer Fahrrad- oder Autofiliale, Verkaufsleiter im Fahrradbereich oder als Zweiradmechatroniker mit Führungsambitionen (m/w/d) siehst. title: Staff Windows Low Level C++ Engineer - Endpoint security
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Our Purpose<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.</p> <h3>About Us<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.</p> <p>Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.</p> <h3><strong>What Are We Looking For?</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.</p></div><p><span data-sheets-root="1">As a Windows Low Level Engineer - Endpoint security, you will design and develop advanced security features for SentinelOne’s Windows endpoint protection platform, operating across both user-mode and kernel-mode environments. You will build and optimize mission-critical components including anti-tampering protections, network sensors, and agent infrastructure while solving complex performance and stability challenges at massive scale. By researching Windows internals and debugging deep system issues, you will collaborate with distributed engineering teams to deliver high-impact security capabilities protecting millions of devices worldwide.</span></p> <p>We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Software Engineer with a strong background in low-level C++ programming and a deep understanding of Windows OS, to help us in developing our <strong>Endpoint Protection product</strong>, the core part of our business, and to join one of our Platform group teams. (<strong>We're currently growing multiple teams</strong> and are open to new colleagues with a wide variety of backgrounds within Windows development!).</p> <p>The <strong>Platform group</strong> teams are in charge of some of our most complex low-level areas, such as:</p> <ul> <li>Windows agent’s Anti-Tampering (self-protection from malware attempting to harm the agent), network sensors, device control, and other kernel-side features involving both research and development,</li> <li>usermode security &amp; agent infrastructures - e.g. installers, logging, services such as communication layer &amp; interfaces for our Windows agent, for improving the quality, performance &amp; stability of the agent and making the user experience smoother.</li> </ul> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">By joining our group, you will collaborate with talented engineers who are leading a feature through the whole development lifecycle. Your work will have an impact on millions of endpoints in one of the mainstream areas of the<a href="https://s1.ai/endpoint" target="_blank"> EPP/EDR agent of SentinelOne</a> - a product recognized 5x-in-a-row as Gartner MQ Leader, scoring highly in many MITRE Att&amp;ck assessments, valued by users in Gartner Peer Insights and more.</span></p> <h3><strong>What will you do?</strong></h3> <ul> <li>As a new member of one of our distributed development teams, you will work in both user-mode &amp; kernel-mode, and deal with a large variety of fields.</li> <li>You will have the chance to design, develop primarily in modern C++ (23), test and debug the most complicated real-world problems (often unseen before). In order to successfully deal with this challenge, you will continuously enrich your knowledge and experience with Windows OS internals &amp; Kernel, Endpoint Protection, and Endpoint Detection &amp; Response eco-system.</li> <li>Our teams design and execute significant new features, as well as rewrite and reimplement the existing ones from scratch. You will also deal with extraordinary performance &amp; optimization challenges, given the scale of our cybersecurity SW (handling hundreds of billions of events every day).</li> <li>Your work will influence the security of tens of millions of Windows devices, that we protect at enterprise &amp; government customers across the globe (incl. 4 of Fortune 10 and hundreds of Global 2000).</li> <li>You’ll also be encouraged to share knowledge within both Platform teams and the broader Windows group.</li> <li><strong>Working setup:</strong> Flexible working hours, this is a 100% remote role on full-time permanent employment based within France. We provide optional membership in major coworking chains. Currently for this role in France we are able to consider only candidates that are already eligible to work in the EU at the time of applying. Optionally for those willing to relocate to the Czech Republic relocation assistance is available for any candidates that are already eligible to work in the EU at the time of applying.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What skills &amp; knowledge should you bring?</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Multiple years of experience as a software engineer in the area of lowlevel programming using modern C++ (or using C and a willingness to learn modern C++)</li> <li>Hands-on experience and in-depth understanding of Windows OS design &amp; internals, Windows low-level development, with debugging of Windows applications and familiarity with related standard debugging and profiling tools</li> <li>Previous experience working on a production-grade product with a wide-scale deployment</li> <li>Great communication skills and the ability to work both independently and with peers from different time zones, problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking</li> <li>Attention to detail and high coding standards</li> <li>An advantage: experience with Windows Kernel and Windows Drivers development, experience in security-oriented development, with reversing or malware analysis</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why SentinelOne?</strong></h3> <p>AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.</p> <p>We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:</p> <p><strong>Equity &amp; Rewards</strong></p> <ul> <li>Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)</li> <li>Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off &amp; Wellbeing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive leave benefits</li> <li>Gender-neutral parental leave</li> </ul> <p><strong>Insurance &amp; Financial Security</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical and insurance benefits</li> <li>Disability insurance</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program (EAP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Work Perks &amp; Flexibility</strong></p> <ul> <li>Global home office allowance</li> <li>Mobile phone reimbursement</li> <li>Work-from-home allowance</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.&nbsp;</span></p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">To learn more about how we use AI in our hiring process, please review our&nbsp;<a href="https://assets.contentstack.io/v3/assets/blt53c99b43892c2378/bltca86b3b84e902400/AI-in-Hiring-SentinelOne.pdf">AI in Hiring Candidate Disclosure</a>.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

This is a strong entry point into tech sales for someone who wants to learn and refine the fundamentals of prospecting, discovery, and pipeline generation inside an enterprise software motion. You'll work directly with Account Executives but will also be responsible for prospecting into your own patch. We ask that all of our ADRs have a remote environment that is conducive to consistent weekly motions and to be able to travel 4-6 times per year, usually a week or less at a time. As an ADR I, you'll run long-term outbound and timely inbound prospecting motions to generate qualified pipeline for our sales team. Working emails, sales cadences, social outreach and most importantly calls to get in front of the right people at the right accounts at the right time. This role exists because a sustainable pipeline is built through persistence, consistency, a growth mindset and an ability to diagnose challenges and bring solutions within your own prospecting motion. Ability and/or willingness to use our product . title: Senior Director EMEA South
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at&nbsp;<a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h2>What You’ll Do:</h2> <p>The Southern Europe Sales organization is responsible for establishing CoreWeave as the preferred AI cloud platform for enterprises, AI labs, digital-native companies, and emerging AI builders across France, Italy, Iberia, and the wider Mediterranean region. The team creates new markets, develops strategic customer relationships, and helps customers use CoreWeave’s infrastructure and software platform to build, deploy, and scale the next generation of AI.</p> <p><strong>About the role: </strong>The Senior Director of Sales, Southern Europe reports to the VP and Managing Director of EMEA. As the senior sales leader for the region, you will own CoreWeave’s commercial strategy and execution across all customer segments, with responsibility for both new-logo acquisition and the growth of existing customers. You will inherit an established customer base and a team spanning Account Executives, Account Managers, and Account Solutions Architects, while carrying a significant mandate to design and build the broader regional coverage model. This is a hands-on, first-on-the-ground leadership role for someone who can build the business, recruit and develop exceptional talent, and support market growth in coordination with EMEA leadership, and personally lead the region’s most strategic customer opportunities.</p> <ul> <li>Own the Southern Europe business, including regional strategy, revenue performance, consumption growth, pipeline creation, customer acquisition, retention, and expansion.</li> <li>Develop and execute a multi-year market-capture plan across France, Italy, Iberia, and the wider Mediterranean region, aligned to CoreWeave’s EMEA and global priorities.</li> <li>Design the regional segmentation, territory, account, and coverage model across Enterprise, AI Labs, Digital Natives, and Startup customers.</li> <li>Build and scale the regional sales organization, recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing leaders and individual contributors as the business grows.</li> <li>Lead, coach, and develop Account Executives and Account Managers, establishing clear expectations, strong inspection disciplines, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Partner closely with Account Solutions Architects to connect customer business objectives with CoreWeave’s infrastructure, platform, and developer capabilities.</li> <li>Personally develop relationships with senior executives, founders, technical leaders, and strategic stakeholders across the region.</li> <li>Lead from the front on the region’s most strategic opportunities, remaining actively involved from initial engagement through solution development, commercial negotiation, and closure, with final contracting execution by EMEA/HQ.</li> <li>Own the acquisition of new strategic customers while developing account strategies that increase adoption, consumption, retention, and long-term customer value across the existing customer base.</li> <li>Build a high-quality, appropriately covered pipeline and establish a consistent operating cadence for opportunity inspection, account planning, forecasting, risk management, and corrective action.</li> <li>Deliver accurate and transparent forecasts, with clear visibility into customer demand, consumption, commercial risk, capacity requirements, and execution dependencies.</li> <li>Develop and close, subject to HQ review and execution, complex, high-value, multi-year commercial agreements, including strategic capacity commitments and enterprise-wide platform relationships.</li> <li>Drive adoption of CoreWeave’s broader platform and software capabilities, ensuring customers see CoreWeave as a strategic technology partner rather than solely an infrastructure provider.</li> <li>Partner across Field Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, Capacity, Product, Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and executive leadership to deliver coordinated customer outcomes.</li> <li>Support CoreWeave’s partner, venture capital, startup ecosystem, sovereign AI, and government-relations strategies across the region.</li> <li>Represent regional customer requirements and market dynamics within CoreWeave, ensuring that global product, capacity, investment, and go-to-market decisions reflect the opportunities and needs of Southern Europe.</li> <li>Establish CoreWeave’s reputation in the region through active participation in the AI, technology, business, research, and investment communities.</li> <li>Build a regional culture that reflects CoreWeave’s values, rewards ownership, develops talent, encourages collaboration, and delivers best-in-class customer experiences.</li> </ul> <h2>Who You Are:</h2> <ul> <li>15+ years of experience in enterprise technology sales, including significant experience selling cloud infrastructure, AI platforms, data platforms, enterprise software, or similarly complex technology solutions.</li> <li>8+ years of sales leadership experience, including responsibility for senior sellers, managers, or multi-country commercial teams.</li> <li>Demonstrated success building or materially scaling a country, regional, or multi-market sales organization.</li> <li>A consistent record of meeting or exceeding significant revenue, bookings, consumption, pipeline, and customer-growth objectives.</li> <li>Experience leading both new-logo acquisition and the expansion of complex, strategic customer relationships.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to develop and close high-value, multi-year agreements involving senior executives, technical stakeholders, procurement teams, legal teams, and other complex buying groups.</li> <li>Experience selling into multiple customer segments, ideally including large enterprises, high-growth technology companies, AI-native businesses, research organizations, and startups.</li> <li>Experience designing segmentation, account allocation, territory, coverage, hiring, and resource-investment models.</li> <li>Strong command of enterprise sales methodologies, account planning, opportunity management, pipeline inspection, forecasting, and performance management.</li> <li>Proven ability to recruit, coach, and develop high-performing sales talent, including leaders and senior individual contributors.</li> <li>The ability to engage credibly with both commercial and deeply technical audiences, translating customer objectives into infrastructure and platform strategies.</li> <li>Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience structuring complex agreements and balancing customer requirements with capacity, risk, margin, and long-term strategic value.</li> <li>A hands-on leadership style and willingness to remain personally involved in strategic selling, executive engagement, and critical negotiations.</li> <li>Proven ability to operate effectively within a fast-growing, globally matrixed organization and align regional execution with global priorities.</li> <li>Fluent English and French language skills.</li> <li>The ability to travel frequently across the region and internationally as required.</li> </ul> <h2>Preferred:</h2> <ul> <li>Leadership experience within an AI cloud, hyperscale cloud, infrastructure, enterprise platform, or consumption-based technology company.</li> <li>Experience building a new region or significantly expanding an early-stage market presence.</li> <li>Experience selling GPU infrastructure, accelerated computing, machine learning platforms, developer tools, or large-scale data and AI solutions.</li> <li>Experience managing commercial opportunities where customer commitments depend on capacity availability, infrastructure deployment, supply, or service readiness.</li> <li>Experience engaging with founders, research organizations, venture capital firms, sovereign entities, or national AI initiatives.</li> <li>Spanish or Italian language skills.</li> <li>An established executive and technology network across Southern Europe.</li> <li>A bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <h2>Wondering if you’re a good fit?</h2> <p>We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.</p> <ul> <li>You are a builder who is energized by the opportunity to create a market, design an organization, and turn an ambitious regional strategy into a scaled business.</li> <li>You lead from the front, combining executive presence and strategic thinking with a willingness to engage deeply in customers, opportunities, and execution.</li> <li>You create clarity and accountability while giving talented people the trust, coaching, and support required to perform at their best.</li> <li>You are comfortable making decisions in an environment where demand, customer requirements, capacity, and priorities are evolving rapidly.</li> <li>You build durable customer relationships by combining commercial ambition with technical curiosity, transparency, and consistent follow-through.</li> <li>You think beyond an individual transaction and seek to establish CoreWeave as a long-term strategic partner to the customers and markets you serve.Why CoreWeave?</li> </ul> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li>Be Curious at Your Core</li> <li>Act Like an Owner</li> <li>Empower Employees</li> <li>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</li> <li>Achieve More Together</li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance&nbsp;</li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution&nbsp;</li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary&nbsp;</li> <li>Critical Illness Cover&nbsp;</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme&nbsp;</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.</em></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Recruitment Agencies</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em><em data-stringify-type="italic">CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms &amp; Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.</em></em></span></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.</em></span></em></p> <p><strong>Export Control Compliance</strong></p> <p><em>This position requires access to technology and/or source code subject to U.S. export control laws. Any such access will be provided only in compliance with applicable U.S. export control requirements. As part of the recruitment process, CoreWeave may request limited information reasonably necessary to assess applicable export-control requirements.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>Updated privacy notice - UK and EU Job Applications&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><em>When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by CoreWeave UK Ltd. (“Controller”), which is located at</em></p> <p><em>Phosphor (6th Floor), 133 Park Street, London, SE1 9EA</em></p> <p><em>and can be contacted by emailing ----- Controller’s data protection officer can be contacted at ----- Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of managing Controller’s recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. </strong>​</p> <p>For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But&nbsp;we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.&nbsp; Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p></div><p></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Position Summary</strong></p> <p>The Supply Chain Planner – Customer Engagement &amp; Engineering serves as the key link between customers, engineering teams, operations, and supply chain functions to ensure material availability, demand fulfillment, and customer satisfaction. This role is responsible for demand planning, inventory optimization, supply risk management, and customer engagement activities while collaborating closely with engineering teams on product changes, new product introductions (NPI), and technical supply chain requirements.</p> <p>The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills, customer-focused communication, and technical understanding to drive supply chain performance and enhance the overall customer experience.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Supply Chain Planning &amp; title: Offre de stage de recherche Master 2 ou dernière année d’école d’ingénieur
description: Dates : 6 mois à partir de février ou mars 2027 Contexte du projet : L’allègement des structures automobiles reste un levier majeur pour réduire la consommation et les émissions des véhicules, tout en répondant à des exigences croissantes de rigidité et de tenue au crash. Les pièces de caisse en blanc sont en grande majorité réalisées à partir de tôles d’acier mises en forme, dont la conception repose encore largement sur l’expertise et sur des itérations successives entre calcul et dessin. L’optimisation topologique permet de déterminer la meilleure répartition de matière dans un domaine de conception donné. Appliquée à un domaine volumique 3D, elle conduit cependant à des structures massives ou de type treillis, difficilement transposables en pièces embouties d’épaisseur quasi constante. Le défi scientifique consiste à formuler une méthode capable de faire émerger, à partir d’un domaine volumique, des géométries représentatives de tôles (structures à parois minces), en maîtrisant l’épaisseur et la fabricabilité, sous chargements statiques puis dynamiques. Ce stage s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une collaboration de recherche entre le LTDS et ArcelorMittal Global R&D. Il a vocation à se poursuivre par une thèse CIFRE en cas de résultats concluants. L’objectif du stage sera de développer et d’évaluer une première méthodologie d’optimisation topologique 3D aboutissant à une solution en tôle d’acier, en s’appuyant sur une structure automobile.
