raw.description:
Dates : 6 mois à partir de février ou mars 2027

Contexte du projet :

L’allègement des structures automobiles reste un levier majeur pour réduire la consommation et les émissions des véhicules, tout en répondant à des exigences croissantes de rigidité et de tenue au crash. Les pièces de caisse en blanc sont en grande majorité réalisées à partir de tôles d’acier mises en forme, dont la conception repose encore largement sur l’expertise et sur des itérations successives entre calcul et dessin.

L’optimisation topologique permet de déterminer la meilleure répartition de matière dans un domaine de conception donné. Appliquée à un domaine volumique 3D, elle conduit cependant à des structures massives ou de type treillis, difficilement transposables en pièces embouties d’épaisseur quasi constante. Le défi scientifique consiste à formuler une méthode capable de faire émerger, à partir d’un domaine volumique, des géométries représentatives de tôles (structures à parois minces), en maîtrisant l’épaisseur et la fabricabilité, sous chargements statiques puis dynamiques.

Ce stage s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une collaboration de recherche entre le LTDS et ArcelorMittal Global R&D. Il a vocation à se poursuivre par une thèse CIFRE en cas de résultats concluants.

L’objectif du stage sera de développer et d’évaluer une première méthodologie d’optimisation topologique 3D aboutissant à une solution en tôle d’acier, en s’appuyant sur une structure automobile.

Les missions pourront comprendre :

•Un état de l’art des méthodes d’optimisation topologique conduisant à des structures minces de type coque (contrôle d’épaisseur par filtrage et projection, contraintes de longueur caractéristique, approches par composants explicites ou level-set).

•Le développement d’un algorithme d’optimisation 3D appliqué à une pièce automobile soumise à des chargements statiques.

•L’extension de la méthode à des solutions plus avancées proposées par ArcelorMittal.

Les missions pourront être adaptées en fonction du profil du candidat et de l’avancement du projet.


Profil recherché : étudiant(e) en Master 2 ou équivalent (stage ingénieur) dans le domaine de la mécanique numérique, du calcul des structures ou des mathématiques appliquées.

Compétences souhaitées : méthode des éléments finis, optimisation numérique, programmation scientifique (Python, MATLAB ou C++). Des connaissances en optimisation topologique ou en dynamique rapide (LS-DYNA, Radioss) seront appréciées.

Encadrement : Frédéric Gillot (LTDS, École Centrale de Lyon) ; Daoming Yu, Alexandre Blaise et Cristian Alvarez (ArcelorMittal Global R&D).

title: Chief of Staff Tech - Engineering
description: Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)? Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy? Then Pennylane is the right place for you ! Our vision We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business. About us Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!) In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to : 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants 💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more... 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor . 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings 🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France! In 2024, we implemented an organizational structure built around business 'tracks'. This approach integrates key stakeholders across marketing, sales, product, and customer care into unified teams focused on specific product lines or client segments. Each track operates as a mini-business, empowered with dedicated resources (e.g., product marketing, data analytics, and operational support) and direct accountability for performance. Why this role matters at Pennylane As Chief of Staff to the CTO, you operate as a senior leader in the Tech organisation. Your leverage does not come from managing teams but from owning the hardest problems that sit between them, and from being technical enough to earn the trust of the other engineering leaders. You are the person the CTO trusts with ambiguous, org-wide problems. You turn that ambiguity into a clear framing, a decision, an owner and a measurable outcome. This is not a coordination role. You are expected to have opinions on engineering strategy, staffing choices and technical trade-offs, and to defend them in front of the Tech leadership team. Team and Context Pennylane's Tech organisation is 70+ squads, each led by an Engineering Manager working with a PM and a Product Designer. We serve 1.5m+ customers and we want to scale in Europe. At that size, the hard problems are no longer inside a squad: how the organisation plans, how it decides, how it measures itself, how it invests in foundations without stalling product delivery. That is your perimeter. You report directly to Quentin, Co-founder & CTO. Your influence comes from the scope of what you own and from credibility with senior engineering leaders, which is why we ask for a technical background. As the organisation grows, this role can evolve towards a management position. Key missions Engineering strategy and transversal initiatives Own the strategic, cross-organization initiatives that no single squad can carry: platform or architecture programmes, reliability and quality step-changes, engineering productivity, technical debt paydown Frame the problem, build the technical and business case, secure alignment across Engineering, Product and Security to drive execution Lead the Tech side of company-level programmes (e.g. European expansion, major compliance or infrastructure shifts) alongside the rest of the Tech leadership Planning & Performance tracking Own the Tech planning cycle: collect the inputs, surface the trade-offs (capacity vs. platform, run vs. new bets), and drive the arbitration with Tech leadership Drive the definition and calibration of Tech OKRs, and hold the organisation accountable Define what "good" looks like for a 70+ squad engineering organization and build the metrics that measure it (delivery cadence, reliability, quality, staffing and attrition, engineering satisfaction) Decision-making and leadership cadence Own the Tech leadership operating system: staff meetings, QBRs, roadmap and architecture reviews. You design them, set the agenda, write or commission the pre-reads, frame the decisions to be made, and make sure decisions land Maintain the CTO's decision log: what was decided, by whom, with what trade-off, and what happened next Raise the quality of decision-making across the Tech leadership team Communication Lead internal and operational communications across the engineering organization, building clear messaging systems from board decks down to team-wide updates Who you’ll work with? CTO and Tech leadership (Head of Engineering / Head of Data / Senior Engineering Managers) Rest of the leadership (CPO, VP Strategic Initiatives) Other relevant teams (e.g. Security, Finance, People) Who we’re looking for Must-have An engineering degree (engineering, computer science or equivalent scientific curriculum) Technical fluency: you can read a design doc, follow an architecture discussion, challenge an estimate or a trade-off, and be taken seriously by senior engineers 7-10 years of experience, including significant time inside a tech organisation at scale (multiple squads, platform teams), where you have lived the problems of scaling engineering A track record of owning complex, cross-organisational initiatives from framing to measurable outcome with senior stakeholders Outstanding written communication: this role produces documents that senior people act on Fluency in English Nice-to-have A hands-on engineering past: software engineer, engineering manager, Technical Program Manager, architect or equivalent Experience as a Chief of Staff, VP/Director of Engineering Operations, or in a strategy & operations function inside a product-led tech company What you can expect? Within one month You'll complete the company and Tech onboarding, including our application, accounting domain and engineering practices You'll have met the Tech leadership team and formed your own view of where the organisation loses time, quality or alignment You'll have taken ownership of the leadership cadence and the next planning milestone Within 3-6 months You'll be leading selected org-wide strategic initiatives end-to-end, with a measurable target The Tech organisation will have a metrics picture it trusts and uses to make decisions You'll be a recognised voice in the senior tech community at Pennylane, consulted on decisions rather than just informed of them You'll be shaping the engineering narrative that the rest of the company and the board hear Recruitment Process - Screening interview with Barbara - Senior Recruiter (30 mins) - An interview with Eric - VP Strategic Initiatives (45 mins) - An interview with Quentin - CTO (1h) - A Business Case to prepare at home and to present (1h) - A final interview with Nathan - Head of Product Strat&Ops (45 mins) What do we do to make your work life easier 🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane 💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package 📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us 🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it ⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness 🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French 💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment 🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone 🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone. If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…) We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries. Who are we looking for ? To thrive at Pennylane, you need : -To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to) -To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment -To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders) -Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria. If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration. Communication

description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As our GNC, ML, Embedded Software, and Validation teams scale, they rely increasingly on simulation to develop and test our autonomous defense systems. The value of that simulation depends directly on how faithfully it reproduces the real behavior of our drones. Joining the Tooling team , you will be responsible for bringing the physical models of our drones into the simulator—including aerodynamics, propulsion, electronics, sensors, and electromechanical systems. Designed by expert domain teams, these models require your expertise to translate user needs, integrate models into the simulator software stack, and validate expected behavior. Because not every use case requires the same level of realism, you will help establish the appropriate fidelity targets across applications. This role offers high ownership and the opportunity to work at the intersection of physics, software engineering, and AI robotics with direct mission impact. Responsibilities Coordination with Domain Experts: Work with the teams in charge of aerodynamics, propulsion, electronics, sensors, and electromechanical systems to understand their models, their assumptions, and their inputs and outputs, and to agree on how they are delivered to the simulator. Model Integration: Integrate these models into the simulator software stack in a clean, performant, and maintainable way, with clear interfaces and configurable parameters. Validation: Define and run tests that check the integrated models against the reference data given by the expert teams (flight logs, bench tests, manufacturer data), and report discrepancies back to the model owners. User Needs & Fidelity Targets: Work with the simulator users (GNC, Embedded, Validation) to understand their use cases, and translate them into a realism target for each model. Pick the right balance between fidelity, performance, and integration effort, and prioritise the model integration work to match. About the Role

As our GNC, ML, Embedded Software, and Validation teams scale, they rely increasingly on simulation to develop and test our autonomous defense systems. The value of that simulation depends directly on how faithfully it reproduces the real behavior of our drones.

Joining the Tooling team, you will be responsible for bringing the physical models of our drones into the simulator—including aerodynamics, propulsion, electronics, sensors, and electromechanical systems. Designed by expert domain teams, these models require your expertise to translate user needs, integrate models into the simulator software stack, and validate expected behavior. Because not every use case requires the same level of realism, you will help establish the appropriate fidelity targets across applications.

This role offers high ownership and the opportunity to work at the intersection of physics, software engineering, and AI robotics with direct mission impact.

Responsibilities

  • Coordination with Domain Experts: Work with the teams in charge of aerodynamics, propulsion, electronics, sensors, and electromechanical systems to understand their models, their assumptions, and their inputs and outputs, and to agree on how they are delivered to the simulator.

  • Model Integration: Integrate these models into the simulator software stack in a clean, performant, and maintainable way, with clear interfaces and configurable parameters.

  • Validation: Define and run tests that check the integrated models against the reference data given by the expert teams (flight logs, bench tests, manufacturer data), and report discrepancies back to the model owners.

  • User Needs & Fidelity Targets: Work with the simulator users (GNC, Embedded, Validation) to understand their use cases, and translate them into a realism target for each model. Pick the right balance between fidelity, performance, and integration effort, and prioritise the model integration work to match.

  • Documentation & Standards: Document the integrated models, their parameters, validity domains, and validation results, and help standardise the model integration and validation process.

  • Integration & Validation: Experience integrating third-party models or components into a larger software system, and validating them against experimental data with a rigorous approach.

  • Experience with drones or robotic systems, ideally with open-source autopilots like PX4 or ArduPilot.

  • Hands-on experience with flight testing, test benches, or log analysis.

  • Rigor: Empirical and disciplined about validation, grounded in real test data, and skeptical of a result that only exists in simulation.

  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication, comfortable working with several specialized teams, asking the right questions, and sharing validation results with them.

title: CDI - Senior AI Engineer - Paris
description: <h2>Mission</h2> <p>De nouveaux modèles, ouverts ou fermés, sortent chaque mois : encore faut-il choisir ceux qui sont assez bons pour la production, et le démontrer. Applications et agents s’appuient sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM), et la partie modèle de ces systèmes est entre vos mains. Nos clients s’en servent pour répondre à leurs propres clients, traiter des documents et interroger leurs connaissances.</p> <p>Ce que le modèle voit, la manière dont il retrouve les connaissances, les outils qu’il peut appeler : ces choix vous appartiennent, de même que la mesure de la qualité des réponses. Le modèle retenu doit tenir l’objectif de coût et de qualité.</p> <p><strong>Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez savoir si un système d’IA donne des réponses justes, et pas seulement s’il tourne.</strong></p> <p>Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype AI Engineer.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Activités et responsabilités</h2> <p>Les Product Engineers construisent l’application autour du modèle ; le comportement du modèle à l’intérieur vous revient. Les Context &amp; Analytics Engineers préparent les connaissances que vos agents retrouvent, et les Platform Engineers exploitent le serving, le harness et l’observabilité sur lesquels vous vous appuyez.</p> <p>Avec l’AI Product Manager et les experts métier du client, une bonne réponse se définit, puis les résultats s’examinent ensemble. La relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues font partie du quotidien.</p> <p><strong>Vos responsabilités :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Construire des applications et des agents LLM : conception du contexte, appel d’outils, workflows multi-étapes.</li> <li>Concevoir la façon dont les agents exploitent les connaissances : requêtes de retrieval, re-ranking, citations.</li> <li>Construire des jeux et des pipelines d’évaluation : réponses de référence, scoring automatisé, relecture par des experts métier.</li> <li>Suivre la qualité des réponses en production et corriger ce qui se dégrade.</li> <li>Choisir les modèles selon la qualité, le coût et la latence ; faire du fine-tuning ou de la distillation sur un modèle plus petit quand le prompting ne suffit pas.</li> <li>Ajouter des garde-fous contre les mauvaises réponses, les fuites de données et le prompt injection.</li> <li>Traiter des documents avec des LLM : extraction, classification, résumés.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Profil recherché</h2> <p><strong>Les indispensables :</strong></p> <ol> <li>Vous avez construit une application ou un agent qui appelle un LLM, et vous savez expliquer ce qui a fonctionné et ce qui a échoué.</li> <li>Votre code est testé et maintenable.</li> <li>Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.</li> <li>La qualité des sorties d’IA se mesure chez vous avec des jeux de test et des métriques, et vous savez limiter les hallucinations, le prompt injection et les fuites de données.</li> <li>Mettre en production une application LLM et la maintenir (déploiement, monitoring, coût, latence) n’a pas de secret pour vous.</li> <li>Le point de départ, pour vous, est le problème métier plutôt que le modèle ; reconnaître que l’IA n’est pas toujours le bon outil, et l’expliquer à des personnes non techniques, fait partie de votre pratique.</li> </ol> <p><strong>Un plus, pas un prérequis :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Du fine-tuning ou de la distillation de modèles de langage.</li> <li>Une formation en machine learning ou en statistiques, par exemple en data science.</li> <li>Des frameworks ou des protocoles d’agents, comme MCP.</li> <li>Des entrées multimodales : documents, images, voix.</li> <li>Des outils d’observabilité LLM : tracing, suivi des coûts.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler</strong> : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?</h2> <p>Dans ce métier, la difficulté est moins de faire parler un modèle que de savoir s’il dit juste. L’AI Engineer répond à cette question par la mesure : jeux de test, évaluations, suivi en production, plutôt que par l’impression d’une démonstration réussie.</p> <p>Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.</p> <p>Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.</p> <p>Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.</p> <p>Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.</p> <p>Le reste s’approfondit sur les projets : évaluation, conception d’agents, adaptation de modèles, avec l’appui de la communauté AI Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype AI Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (responsabilité en production, bases de la sécurité de l’IA).</p> <p>Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Processus de recrutement</h2> <p>Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.</p> <ol> <li><strong>Entretien RH</strong> (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.</li> <li><strong>Appel avec le CTO</strong> (15 à 30 min, à distance).</li> <li><strong>Screening technique</strong> (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.</li> <li><strong>Code review et live coding</strong> (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.</li> <li><strong>Cas technique</strong> (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.</li> <li><strong>Entretien final</strong> (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.</li> </ol> <p>Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Rémunération&nbsp;</strong>: 53 000€ à 70 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + variable selon expérience et séniorité</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.</em></p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Pre-Sales / Sales Engineer
description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐️ The Pre-Sales role ⭐️ Our Pre-Sales team strengthens Alan’s Enterprise and Public sector Sales to better handle the specificities of our largest customers. Here are the main missions of the team you will join: Master our platform and support Sales team by enabling them with insights, expertise and the relevant tools; Listen and understand prospects’ needs and work internally on how Alan can address them best; Build a thorough understanding of the prospect and assess the level of functional alignment with our offering and capabilities; Participate to RFP submissions and build Alan’s response in collaboration with Sales, Insurance and Product experts; Join the customer acquisition journey to evangelize our services and products; Act as voice of the customer feeding Alan’s platform roadmap; Prepare handover for delightful customers’ onboardings; Eventually coordinate the most complex customer onboardings leveraging your unique knowledge of the customer’s requirements and specificities. You will actively participate in developing this growing function within Alan and edit the company to make our Sales teams the most successful of all! Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Pre-Sales role ⭐️

Our Pre-Sales team strengthens Alan’s Enterprise and Public sector Sales to better handle the specificities of our largest customers.

Here are the main missions of the team you will join:

  • Master our platform and support Sales team by enabling them with insights, expertise and the relevant tools;

  • Listen and understand prospects’ needs and work internally on how Alan can address them best;

  • Build a thorough understanding of the prospect and assess the level of functional alignment with our offering and capabilities;

  • Participate to RFP submissions and build Alan’s response in collaboration with Sales, Insurance and Product experts;

  • Join the customer acquisition journey to evangelize our services and products;

  • Act as voice of the customer feeding Alan’s platform roadmap;

  • Prepare handover for delightful customers’ onboardings;

  • Eventually coordinate the most complex customer onboardings leveraging your unique knowledge of the customer’s requirements and specificities.

You will actively participate in developing this growing function within Alan and edit the company to make our Sales teams the most successful of all!

Given the growing need for onsite customer engagement, you are ideally located in Paris or the Île-de-France region (or within a 2-hour door to door distance with the flexibility to travel to Paris on short notice for customer meetings).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-E level range.

⭐️ You will be a great fit if ⭐️

  • You have 6+ years of experience working in a SaaS environment, including at least 3 in a Pre-Sales / Sales Engineering / Solution Consultant role.

  • You have a talent for quickly getting to the root cause of customers concern through active listening and requirements elicitation;

  • You are assertive and know how to handle objections in a complex environment;

  • You master the art of pitching a product with transparency and without overselling its capabilities ;

  • You have the ability to break down complex issues and identify product gaps to define the best product solutions;

  • You thrive at high level stakeholders’ management;

  • You excel at prioritizing tasks while living up to commitments;

  • You love teamwork and are always eager to learn and grow;

  • You are fluent in both French and English;

It would be even better if you have:

  • Experience with end-to-end procurement projects (buyer or supplier side) with involvement in RFI’s, RFQ’s and RFP’s;

  • Experience in the French Public Sector;

  • Experience in HRIS ecosystems and Payroll solutions;

  • Experience in Insurance or Health platforms.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

⭐️ The Account Executive (Small Businesses) job

Your mission

Join our Small Businesses team targeting companies with 10-30 employees across tech, consulting, and business services, the market segment where Alan has the strongest product-market fit and brand recognition. You'll work in a high-velocity environment with strong conversion rates, and the opportunity to make an immediate impact on hundreds of growing French companies.

What you'll own

  • Full sales cycle: From prospection to closing

  • Strategic relationships: Drive deals and manage key customer relationships

  • Education & demos: Deliver inspiring product demonstrations and guide stakeholders through the evaluation process

The Alan way of selling

We've developed the Alan Smart & Soft selling method:

  • Smart: Leverage precise messaging and materials to educate and inspire

  • Soft: Create tailored, high-touch strategies for each prospect

  • Experience: Deliver a seamless journey that reflects Alan's customer-first approach

Beyond sales

As an Alan team member, you'll:

  • Shape our product evolution

  • Contribute to improving our methods and strategy

  • Participate in growth initiatives

  • Be part of a collaborative team that thinks big

Join us in revolutionizing healthcare through technology and human connection 🌟

Meet Estelle Berdugo one of our Account Executives.


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Small Businesses Team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 3 years of experience managing the whole Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. Prospection is a key part of the role;

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English.

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills;

  • Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

  • Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

  • Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

  • Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

  • Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the B1-C0 level range.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Simulation as infrastructure: a GPU-backed simulation environment (Isaac Sim today) running continuously, so engineers test against scenarios instead of queueing for the one robot in the lab. Scenario libraries and regression suites: coverage across the whole on-robot stack, perception through locomotion, and the infrastructure to run thousands of scenarios on every change. Hardware-in-the-loop: bench rigs and test procedures on the physical robots for what simulation cannot tell you. Failure injection: drop sensors, degrade LiDAR returns, kill the network link, corrupt odometry, then verify the system degrades and recovers the way we tell customers it does. Dann bist du bei BSI goldrichtig!


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest den stabilen und effizienten Betrieb unserer SaaS-Plattform auf AWS, Azure und T-Systems sicher und sorgst für die Einhaltung unserer SLAs

  • Du entwickelst unsere Observability mit Prometheus und Grafana weiter, analysierst Störungen und führst Root-Cause-Analysen durch. Als Teil des Teams übernimmst du zudem 2nd-Level-Support und die Rufbereitschaft

  • Du betreust über 20 Cluster, auf denen unsere gesamte Kundenbasis läuft – inklusive Lifecycle, Updates und Weiterentwicklung der Plattform

  • Du automatisierst den Aufbau und die Verwaltung unserer Cloud-Infrastruktur mit Terraform und sorgst mit ArgoCD, Docker und CI/CD dafür, dass neue Anwendungen zuverlässig und automatisiert auf Kubernetes bereitgestellt werden

  • Du sorgst für sichere und widerstandsfähige Systeme, entwickelst Backup- und Disaster-Recovery-Konzepte weiter und stellst deren Praxistauglichkeit regelmässig auf die Probe

  • Du hältst unsere Dokumentation aktuell, optimierst Abläufe und automatisierst, was nicht manuell erledigt werden muss

Wir suchen Macher

  • Abgeschlossene Lehre, mind. 3 Jahre Erfahrung in diesem Gebiet 

  • Breite Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Netzwerk, Security, Virtualisierung, Container (Docker/Kubernetes)

  • Erfahrung mit Automatisierungstools (Ansible, Terraform) und Skriptsprachen (Bash, Python)

  • Fundiertes Linux Knowhow (Ubuntu/Debian, RedHat/CentOS)

  • Neugier, effizientes Arbeiten und unternehmerisches Denken

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Starke Gründe für BSI

  • Unternehmerische Gestaltungs- und Beteiligungsmöglichkeiten in wertschätzender Firmenkultur frei von Hierarchien

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Orte 

  • Möglichkeit zum Ferienkauf, Sabbatical und Workation innerhalb der EU

About the role

Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers.

Own the software that drives our hardware. You'll write the control planes, automation, and observability that keep our global fleet fast, efficient, and reliable, while charting a path to scale that continues to increase the number of "machines under management" per engineer.

Recognising the need for innovation in the traditional employee insurance model we are set to revolutionize the employee insurance industry. We help companies support people before and after they get sick and to make more of their time. Our insurance solutions reduce monotonous and manual work for employees, doctors, HR & payroll managers. As we strive to lead a technology-driven transformation, we put employees first.
 
At grape we pride ourselves on our people and our culture. We continue to grow fast and that’s where you come in. Our team is dynamic, diverse and full of creative ideas. Want to join? We can’t wait to get to know you!

Your role

As Head of Distribution, you own grape’s commercial engine end to end: Broker Sales, Direct Sales, Brand & Marketing, Customer Success and Revenue Operations. You carry the new nARR and renewal targets and lead the team leads who deliver them. 
You take this function over from our co-founder, grow it further, and represent Distribution on grape’s Leadership Team.


What you'll do:

  1. Own the numbers: Deliver new nARR and renewal targets across broker, direct and partner channels. Own forecast accuracy, pipeline health and the channel mix.

  2. Lead the commercial organisation: Lead five team leads, set OKRs, hold the performance bar, develop the next layer of leaders and hire ahead of growth.

  3. Win the broker channel: Own decision-maker relationships with key broker houses and steer the tender season on quality, speed and win rate.

  4. Build the end-to-end funnel: Set clear stage ownership and KPIs from first touch to renewal. Align closely with underwriting on deal flow and pricing, and steer RevOps on tooling, data quality and forecasting.

  5. Retain and grow the book: Own the renewal rate and retention playbook, drive platform and grape connect adoption, and turn customer and broker insight into product input.

  6. Work across the company: Represent Distribution on the Leadership Team and in board reporting. Partner with Product, Insurance Supply and Operations.


What you'll need:
  • 10+ years in commercial roles, including 5+ years leading a multi-team organisation through team leads.
  • A track record of delivering multi-million B2B revenue targets repeatedly.
  • Experience in a B2B market sold through intermediaries; Swiss insurance, employee benefits or pensions is a strong plus.
  • Experience scaling a commercial organisation, ideally in a venture-backed company.
  • Strong pipeline, forecasting and funnel analytics; uses CRM (ideally HubSpot) as a steering tool.
  • Understanding of, or a fast route to learning, insurance commercial mechanics: premium, loss ratio and renewal pricing.
  • VBV registration, or readiness to obtain it promptly.
  • Fluent German and English; French and Swiss German are a plus.
  • Credible with brokers, your team and the Board; direct, data-driven and comfortable disagreeing upward.

title: Leader, EMEA Product Support
description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma. We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today. ROLE OVERVIEW The Leader, EMEA Product Support role manages Benchling support in EMEA. As the team leader (a player-coach role), you’ll manage Product Support Analalyts in Europe and spend roughly 40% of your time directly owning customer issues and our most complex escalations. This role owns live customer-impacting incidents for enterprise pharma and biotech customers, helps shape an AI-first support model, and sits close to CX leadership. Working closely with our Global Support and CX Leadership Teams, you’ll combine team leadership, incident management, and thoughtful AI adoption to help scale a modern, efficient Support organization. RESPONSIBILITIES Lead and coach your team: run daily regional support operations including prioritization and resourcing, hold regular team meetings and career growth conversations, and build a culture where people feel supported and excited to grow. Partner with the Incident Center of Excellence to mature the incident process (post-incident reviews, closing action items, communication playbooks, severity-based response criteria), and help build and run a sustainable off-hours coverage model, including personally rotating in as an escalation responder. Analyze support metrics (volume, severity trends, time-to-resolution, comms timeliness) to inform staffing and process decisions, and report trends to CX leadership. Drive consistent adoption of AI tools across support workflows, piloting ways to reduce ticket-handling time, surface account context automatically, and free up analyst time for higher-value work. Collaborate with Build, Product, Technical Account Managers, Customer Success, and Professional Services on customer issues and incidents, keep help content and product knowledge current, and represent support at customer-facing events as needed. Work the queue alongside your team: own complex, high-priority, and escalated tickets, serve as a first-line contact for regional escalations, and model the troubleshooting, investigation, and communication standards you expect from others. QUALIFICATIONS Experienced leader who coaches with empathy and stays close to the work, with 1+ years of management experience and 5+ years of SaaS support or professional services, or demonstrated leadership, including assigning ticket work and managing queues and resources. Able to personally troubleshoot and resolve complex customer issues. Working knowledge of support and incident tooling and best practices for technical support environments (e.g. Salesforce, Zendesk, JIRA, PagerDuty, or equivalent), plus genuine enthusiasm for AI in support, ideally with hands-on experience piloting or driving adoption. Sound judgment under pressure: prioritizing by urgency, severity, and customer health context, and skilled in customer-facing crisis communication, including what to say, when, and to whom during a live incident, and how to translate root cause into clear RCAs/ISNs. Experience with enterprise-grade support: managing high-stakes accounts holistically, building trust with sophisticated customers, and thinking beyond individual ticket resolution. Strong communicator and customer advocate with a bias toward action, comfortable working independently across departments, remote teams, and external stakeholders. Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences related field recommended (biology, microbiology, genetics, biotechnology, neurology, etc.); research or lab experience is a big plus. Based in the Zurich area, or willing to relocate, and able to work on-site in our Zurich office Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. HOW WE WORK We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday). #LI-Hybrid #LI-Remote #BI-Hybrid #BI-Remote Benchling welcomes everyone. We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. title: Stage Privacy & Data
description: Ben jij een student die energie krijgt van processen doorgronden en puzzels oplossen, met interesse in privacy en data? Wil je bijdragen aan een duurzamere wereld en zien hoe nieuwe wetgeving landt in een snel groeiend bedrijf? Dan is MyWheels op zoek naar jou! Over MyWheels MyWheels gelooft in een toekomst waarin je mobiliteit inricht op wat je écht nodig hebt, niet op wat je bezit. Toegang tot de juiste auto, op het juiste moment. Wij bouwen het platform dat dat mogelijk maakt. Als grootste elektrische mobiliteitsplatform van Nederland gaan we verder dan toegang tot een auto. Via Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) leveren onze elektrische auto’s ook stroom terug aan het energienet. Zo pakken we tegelijk de netcongestie aan en bouwen we aan de energie- én mobiliteitsvoorziening van de toekomst. ⚡ Vanuit ons kantoor in Amsterdam werkt een enthousiast team van zo’n 50 mensen aan dit platform. Samen bouwen we aan iets wat echt telt. Wat ga je doen? Als stagiair Privacy & Data ondersteun je ons bij het verder brengen van ons privacy-programma in de breedste zin van het woord. Je werkt mee aan onze processen en verwerkingen, en verdiept je in de Leidraad Data Delen van de ACM, die praktische richtlijnen geeft over hoe de Europese Data Act door Nederlandse bedrijven moet worden uitgevoerd. Je werkt nauw samen met onze Security Lead, die je begeleidt, en kunt steunen op zijn contacten met onze Functionaris Gegevensbescherming en de Legal Counsel van onze moedermaatschappij. Je werkt nauw samen met onze Security Lead, jouw begeleider. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Je houdt ons register van verwerkingen actueel en brengt onze processen en verwerkingen visueel in kaart, in gesprek met collega’s uit alle teams; Je verdiept je in de Leidraad Data Delen en helpt uitzoeken wat dat betekent voor MyWheels en onze deelauto’s; Je duikt in klantklachten over privacy en ontrafelt de lastige gevallen: wat is er gebeurd, en hoe lossen we het op?; Signaleren van quick wins en verbeterkansen op het gebied van privacy en data. Verbondenheid met de duurzame impact doelstellingen van MyWheels; Je hebt interesse in de praktische kant van wet-en regelgeving en dan voornamelijk op het gebied van privacy en data; Je volgt een juridische opleiding, bij voorkeur WO Rechtsgeleerdheid of HBO Rechten, maar iedere student met de juiste interesse is welkom; Je zoekt een meewerkstage om praktijkervaring op te doen; Je bent zelfstandig, proactief en leergierig en durft kritische vragen te stellen; Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk; Het is een pré als je al iets weet van de AVG of de Data Act. The good stuff 👇 Een stage met een duurzame missie; Een stagevergoeding van € 400 bruto per maand o.b.v. 40-urige werkweek, passend bij je werkervaring; Een open werksfeer en borrels; Ruimte voor ideeën en initiatieven; Flexibiliteit en hybride werken; Een laptop in bruikleen. Jouw werktijden Je loopt 32 tot 40 uur per week stage binnen een hybride werkstructuur. Onze werktijden zijn van 09:00 tot 17:30, waarbij je minimaal twee dagen per week op ons kantoor in Amsterdam bent. Waar kom je te werken? Ons kantoor is vlak bij treinstation Amsterdam Bijlmer Arena. Daar werk je samen met een enthousiast team van ongeveer 50 collega’s met specialisaties in onder andere sales, operations, development en finance. Iedereen draagt vanuit zijn of haar expertise bij aan één gezamenlijk doel: de groei van MyWheels en het bouwen aan slimmere mobiliteit. Sollicitatieproces: Wij reageren op jouw sollicitatie binnen 14 dagen; Kennismakingsgesprek met Jamal (Security Lead) Welkom aan boord! Interesse? Wil je meehelpen om impact te maken? Stuur dan je sollicitatie inclusief cv en motivatie naar ons toe. We nemen dan zo snel mogelijk contact met je op. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: <p>Register your interest below. This is an expression of interest, not a job application, and it does not start an assessment process.</p> <p>Looking to start full-time in 2027? Our Graduate Quantitative Researcher (2027 Start) role is currently open.<a href="https://www.optiver.com/join-us/jobs/quantitative-research-and-machine-learning/amsterdam/graduate-quantitative-researcher-2027-start/?gh_jid=8585609002"> Apply here.</a></p> <p>If you enjoy using mathematics and code to investigate difficult questions, you could make a direct contribution to Optiver’s success in global markets. As a Graduate Quantitative Researcher, you’ll work across the full research process, from framing the question and choosing the data to building, testing and deploying models. Machine Learning is central to the work, whether you’re extracting signals, forecasting prices or modelling relationships. Our data, compute and production infrastructure let you test ideas quickly, understand where they fail and decide what to investigate next.</p> <p>Our researchers believe in academic discourse and invite fellow researchers, traders and engineers to challenge each hypothesis. Different perspectives help improve the question, the model and how it performs in production. Through constant testing, analysis and refinement, you’ll help our quantitative models adapt as markets evolve.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO</strong></p> <p><strong>Your onboarding&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>You’ll&nbsp;participate&nbsp;in&nbsp;<a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ONPObMHh-k8">Global Optiver Academy</a>, a structured&nbsp;onboarding programme for graduates. It gives new joiners a shared foundation in how Optiver trades, builds systems, and manages risk before they move into their teams.&nbsp;As part of your onboarding,&nbsp;you'll&nbsp;gain exposure to the AI tools and technologies that support research and development across the business.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Your responsibilities&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Depending on the team you join, you'll own the research end to end. That could include:</p> <ul> <li>Building models for pricing, forecasting and signal discovery, choosing the statistical, mathematical or Machine Learning methods that best fit the problem.</li> <li>Working across petabytes of market, order-flow and unstructured data to find signals that improve strategies as conditions change.</li> <li>Monitoring models in production and using live behavior to refine your assumptions and decide what to investigate next.</li> <li>Using deep learning and AI-enabled workflows to shorten the loop from hypothesis to evidence.</li> <li>Working directly with researchers, traders and engineers to shape problems and understand how system constraints affect performance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHO YOU ARE</strong></p> <p>We're looking for aspiring Quantitative Researchers who are versatile and creative in innovating and suggesting new solutions. In return, we'll give you the freedom to pursue your ideas and implement them right into our production systems.&nbsp;</p> <p>In terms of skills and qualifications, we're looking for:</p> <ul> <li>An academic degree in Engineering, Physics, Maths, Econometrics, Computer science or equivalent, with outstanding academic achievements</li> <li>Programming experience in any language (preferably Python, but C, C++, Basic, JAVA, etc. are also a plus)</li> <li>Ability to apply concepts of probability, calculus and linear algebra</li> <li>Competitive attitude and eagerness to constantly improve</li> <li>Ability to learn quickly</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written English language skills</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL GET</strong></p> <p>You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. Motivated by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high-performing environment alongside talent colleagues, working collaboratively to tackle the toughest problems in the financial markets.</p> <p>In addition, you’ll receive:</p> <ul> <li>A performance-based bonus structure, enabling all of our employees to benefit from our global profit pool</li> <li>The opportunity to work alongside best-in-class professionals from over 50 countries</li> <li>25 paid vacation days in your first year, increasing to 30 from your second year onwards</li> <li>Training opportunities, discounts on health benefits, and fully paid first-class commuting expenses</li> <li>Extensive office perks, including breakfast, lunch and dinner, world-class barista coffee, bi-weekly chair massages, Friday afternoon drinks, a bicycle to explore Amsterdam and much more</li> <li>Training and continuous learning opportunities, including access to conferences and tech events</li> <li>Competitive relocation packages and visa sponsorship where necessary for expats</li> </ul> <p><strong>HOW TO REGISTER</strong></p> <p>Are you interested in furthering your career on one of the most dynamic and exciting trading floors in Europe?</p> <p>Complete the short form below with your details and upload your CV in English. Registering your interest is not a job application, and it does not start an assessment process. We'll contact you when we have opportunities that match your profile.</p> <p>Kindly note that we do not require any assistance from third-parties including agencies in the recruitment of this role. If you have any questions feel free to contact our Recruitment team via our <a href="https://optiver.com/contact-eu-recruitment/">recruitment inquiry form.</a></p> <p><strong>Diversity statement</strong></p> <p>Optiver is committed to <a href="https://optiver.com/diversity-statement/">diversity and inclusion</a>.</p> <p>We encourage applications from candidates from any and all backgrounds, and we welcome requests for reasonable adjustments during the process to ensure that you can best demonstrate your abilities. title: Quantitative Researcher - 2027 Graduates
description: <p>At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge?</p> <p>As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly.</p> <p>This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job.</p> <p>Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices.</p> <h2>What You'll Work On</h2> <p>You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include:</p> <ul> <li>Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events</li> <li>Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them</li> <li>Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading</li> <li>Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise</li> <li>Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible</li> <li>Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales</li> <li>Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models</li> <li>Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper</li> <li>Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems</li> <li>Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge</li> </ul> <p>No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist.</p> <h2>What Success Looks Like</h2> <p>Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable.</p> <h2>Who We're Looking For</h2> <p>We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious.</p> <ul> <li>Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning</li> <li>No active backlogs</li> <li>Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++</li> <li>Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects</li> <li>Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking</li> <li>A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly</li> </ul> <p>Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance before.</p> <h2>Our Culture</h2> <p>More than specific tools or techniques, we care how you think. raw.title: Sentinel System Engineer - Post Launch Support
raw.description:
We are looking for a Sentinel System Engineer on behalf of the European Space Agency (ESA) for their location in Noordwijk, the Netherlands. 

 

Please note, the successful candidate will be employed by ATG Europe (or one of its subsidiaries). Furthermore, upon selection, they will be subject to a general security screening performed by an external provider (further information will be provided at the interview stage). 

 

ATG is dedicated to diversity and inclusion and is an equal opportunity employer. Regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, or any other reason protected by relevant state or municipal legislation, we are pleased to consider all eligible candidates for employment. 

 

The successful candidate will be tasked with, but not limited to: 

 

  • Coordinate the internal & external support to PLS (ESA Space Segment Development Team, TEC experts, Mission Analysis & System Support, Industry);  

  • Coordinate with the ESA Space Segment Development Team (where relevant) to exchange technical status on the flying- and non-flying satellite(s), identifying coordination issues of relevance and following them to conclusion;  

  • Support PLS at the regular (weekly) Operations Boards; 

  • Support the Operations Team(s) by providing or facilitating responses to technical support requests from either the Flight Operations Segment (FOS) or Payload Data Ground Segment (PDGS);  

  • Maintain & distribute the PLS On-Call lists to the FOS (& other parties where relevant) in a timely manner; 

  • Support the Mission Manager and his/her team by providing technical advice related to issues of Satellite(s) performance; 

  • Support the Space Segment Development Team(s) by providing timely & pertinent feedback on any issue detected in-flight with potential impact on satellite(s) still under development;  

  • Provide specific technical expertise to support Performance Monitoring, Analysis & Optimisation tasks and Anomaly Investigations, with overall aim to improve mission quality and/or lifetime; 

  • Preparation of Technical Documentation, such as Reports, Technical Notes and other requested documentation; 

  • Review and synthesis of Technical Reports and documents produced by Industry, and extraction of relevant technical information for use in generation of PLS Performance metrics and reports; 

  • Organise and support the 6-monthly Satellite In-Orbit Performance (SIOP) Technical Meetings in cooperation with the Industrial Prime contractor, including associated follow-up activities (eg. administration, actions follow up etc); 

  • Respond to Anomaly Warnings received from the Flight Operations Segment (FOS) in an appropriate & timely manner, providing support and facilitating the necessary follow-on actions;  

  • Support and lead complex investigations that arise as a result of satellite performance and anomalies, ensuring adequate coordination with involved partners (Mission Management, Operations Team(s), Industry, Space Segment Development Team(s), Management);   

  • Prepare, coordinate & follow-up on engineering requests for the Industrial contractors in support of Anomaly Investigations and other technical analyses;   

  • Support satellite configuration control including the Configuration Control Board (CCB);   

  • Support Satellite Decommissioning & Disposal activities as required;   

  • Monitor, track and report the status of activities performed by the Industrial contractors in support of the PLS function (technical, commercial and schedule status);  

  • Review commercial payment requests & the associated justifications submitted by Industry (regular milestones or as result of ad-hoc Cost Reimbursement activities);   

  • Bring innovation to satellite performance analysis by investigating emerging technologies that enhance the ability for early detection of performance trends and deviations;   

  • Maintain the relevant PLS technical records, databases & documentation in accordance with established procedures;   

  • Maintain a regular reporting in coordination with the Technical Officer. 


Please ensure that your CV clearly explains how you meet the mandatory requirements. If it doesn’t align completely with the essential criteria, it could result in rejection. 

Requirements  

  • University degree in a relevant Engineering discipline;   

  • Minimum 10 years of experience and a significant background in one or more of the following domains: Satellite Operations, Spacecraft Development (including Project Engineering, Equipment/Subsystem Procurement, Assembly Integration & Test);   

  • Minimum 3 years’ experience working as a System Engineer or with a System Coordination function in any of the above domains;   

  • Good understanding of the Satellite Phase E2 Routine Operations Organisation and the typical activities performed;   

  • Good understanding of the factors affecting the short- and long-term performance of Satellites and their main subsystems or payloads;   

  • Experience managing and leading technical meetings and discussions with multiple stakeholders;

  • Proven experience & ability at working in an environment with multiple external interfaces;   

  • Good at working in a team and a proactive attitude to solving problems  

  • Autonomy in writing technical notes, specifications and reports in English;   

  • Good interpersonal skills and team spirit;   

  • Demonstrable multidisciplinary or system-level experience in the satellite engineering domain;  

  • Previous working experience in a multinational environment is desirable;  

  • Very good knowledge of MS Office tools; 

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken; 

  • Candidates must be eligible to work in the EU. 

 

Please submit your application in English via the apply button below. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.

raw.title: (Senior) Recruiter - Growing Impact Scale Up
raw.description:
Join us in Revolutionizing Supply Chains
We’re a fast-growing SaaS scale-up on a mission to shape a sustainable future for the food industry. With four years of continuous 100% year-on-year growth, our team is expanding quickly. We’re looking for a proactive, highly organised Recruiter to help us find the people who will drive that growth, and to help shape how we work as we scale. Join us and shape the future of food sustainability with us!

About Simvia

Ensuring responsible supply chains is one of the largest challenges of our time. At Simvia we are on a path to enable the food and consumer goods industry to become a force for good, by making it simple to prove that what we eat and use is safe, compliant, and sustainable. 

Several of Europe's largest retailers, from Albert Heijn to Edeka, have joined Simvia together with their suppliers, and our network now spans more than 200,000 suppliers in 130 countries. AI gives us a strong tailwind: our network holds unique data, and much of the manual work in compliance can now be automated. We are growing rapidly and keep scaling with a driven, international team of 75+ people in the heart of Amsterdam. 

About this role

You will be our first in-house Recruiter. There is no recruitment playbook yet, so you build it: the process, the guardrails and the habits that let us hire fast and well as we scale. That calls for someone who thinks "I'll find a way" rather than "what's the rule here?" 

Sourcing is the heart of the job. Most of your impact comes from finding and convincing great people who were not looking. Every person you bring in shapes the company we become, so we want someone who lives our culture, not only someone who can describe it. 

Who thrives here

Our culture is driven and kind, and it only works if you bring both. 

Driven by the mission. You set ambitious goals, own the outcome, and welcome a high bar. 

Frank. You say what you think and would rather hear the truth than a comfortable story. 

Open. You ask for feedback and change your mind when the facts change. 

Trusting. You build real relationships and give others room to own their work. 

If this sounds more draining than energizing, that is a useful signal too. 

What you will work on

  • Sourcing and approaching great people across sales, customer success, product and engineering, through LinkedIn, referrals and cold calls, so most of our hires come from you rather than agencies 

  • Building our recruitment process from scratch: clear steps, interview templates and scorecards that every hiring manager follows 

  • Running several hiring processes at once, from role profile to signed offer, with candidates always knowing where they stand 

  • Holding hiring managers, senior leaders included, to agreed timelines and fast feedback 

  • Tracking time to hire, source effectiveness and funnel conversion, and using the numbers to improve how we hire 

  • Helping our People & Culture team with in-house events and office life in quieter hiring periods 

What you bring

  • 3+ years as a recruiter, in-house or agency, with hires across SaaS or tech roles from sales to R&D 

  • Real sourcing strength: direct approach and cold calls give you energy, and you can point to hires you found yourself 

  • A builder's mindset: you enjoy setting up processes, templates and guardrails where none exist yet 

  • Highly organized: you run many roles and steps at once without dropping anything 

  • You enjoy speed, and you are assertive with senior stakeholders while staying warm with candidates 

  • You already use AI and automation in your work and are curious about the next tool

  • Fluent English, written and spoken 

Nice to have

  • German and/or Dutch, German being the most useful 

  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up 

  • Experience with an ATS and LinkedIn Recruiter 

What we offer

  • A high-paced organization with room to grow your career 

  • A meaningful mission: help the food and consumer goods industry become a force for good 

  • Training and support, a pension contribution and travel reimbursement 

  • Fresh lunch every day, monthly Thirsty Thursdays, hackathons, boat parties and our annual dance event 

  • At least three days per week in our Amsterdam city center office, with two rooftop terraces 

How we hire

An intro call with our People & Culture team, a conversation with the hiring manager, an assignment, a culture conversation and an offer. Every process includes an assignment, because we would rather see your work than hear about it. We move fast and keep you informed at every step. 

Diversity & Inclusion at Simvia

We hire people with different backgrounds, cultures, and views because it makes our work better. Whoever you are, wherever you are from, whoever you love and whatever you believe in, you are welcome here.

raw.title: Senior Product Manager, Financial Statement Suite
raw.description:
Before a company publishes its annual report, finance teams have to turn financial data into a complete set of statements and disclosures. Balances need to be mapped, figures carried forward and updated, and supporting information brought together into a draft. Auditors then check that the notes match the primary statements, this year reconciles with last year, and every total adds up. Preparing and reviewing those statements takes days of detailed work, and errors can carry through into a published report.

Today, audit teams rely on Financial Statement Suite (FSS) to read statements, run checks, and show reviewers what it found and where, so they can make the call and stand behind it. The opportunity goes beyond reconciliation: helping auditors and financial professionals review drafts, connect figures to supporting evidence, and manage changes through to sign-off.

You'll own what FSS becomes across preparation and review cycles. You'll decide what sits on the teams roadmap and define strategy for this high opportunity area working with engineering, design, audit experts and the firms who use FSS every day.

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

 

What impact you will have

  • Own the end-to-end strategy and decisions for our financial statements product, with clear domain ownership

  • Lead product direction in a key area with direct and clear business impact

  • Reimagine how auditors and financial professionals work, making their workflows more defensible

Why it's an exciting challenge

  • Reviewers are sceptical, and they should be. A finding they can't trace is a finding they check again by hand.

  • Statements differ by country, by standard and by firm. FSS has to be right on all of them, not just the ones in front of you this week.

  • Firms use FSS when the stakes are highest. Every change has to make their next busy season better, not riskier.

  • Everyone has a request: firms, sales, partners and engineering. You'll decide which ones the evidence supports, and say no to the rest.

What you'll own

  • The full FS experience: how a team moves through a draft, from the first finding to sign-off

  • Trust in every check: each finding shows what it compared, where the figures came from, and who reviewed it

  • Quality: what "ready to ship" means for each check, and how the team knows a change helps without breaking something else

  • Where FSS goes next: which statement types, standards and markets come first, and why

     

What you'll do

  • Set the plan and make trade-offs explicit, including new checks versus improving the ones customers already rely on

  • Spend time with auditors: watch real reviews, see where they double-check by hand, and turn that into product decisions

  • Work with engineering and audit experts on sets of real statements that every change has to pass

  • Use product data to decide: which findings reviewers accept, reject or ignore, and why

  • Build on Alwin's shared platform capabilities, and raise dependencies with other teams early

  • Help sales and customer success decide which customers and statements FSS is ready for

  • Write clearly: decisions, specs, and requirements so the team can drive forward with clarity and speed

What you'll bring

Must-have:

  • Product management experience on B2B software where getting it right matters: audit, accounting, tax, legal, compliance or financial services

  • A strong business acumen and focus on business impact

  • Experience shipping AI, machine learning or document-processing features, and making their output something people can check

  • Comfort with data: you can read an error analysis, query your own numbers and spot a sample that isn't representative

  • A record of prioritising for a large user base with demanding customers and competing stakeholders both internal and external

  • Enough technical depth to make trade-offs with engineers on accuracy, data and architecture

Strong-to-have:

  • An audit or accounting background, or deep knowledge of financial reporting (IFRS, US GAAP, UK GAAP)

  • Creative mindset thinking beyond how problems are solved today to reimagine a future approach that drive productivity

  • Experience in agentic products, workflows and systems

Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders at all levels.
