description: Jouw impact als Senior Social & AI Marketeer Als Senior Social & AI Marketeer bij Indicia ben je het strategische aanspreekpunt voor grote klanten en vertaal je hun commerciële doelstellingen naar effectieve socialmediastrategieën. Je combineert strategisch advies met een hands-on aanpak en ontwikkelt en optimaliseert campagnes op platforms als Meta, LinkedIn en TikTok. Daarbij werk je met grote mediabudgetten en krijg je volop ruimte om impact te maken. AI speelt een belangrijke rol in jouw werk. Je benut slimme tools en automatisering om campagnes, content en processen continu te verbeteren. Daarnaast signaleer je proactief commerciële kansen bij klanten en deel je jouw kennis en ervaring met junior marketeers. Zo draag je niet alleen bij aan het succes van klanten, maar ook aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het team en de dienstverlening van Indicia. Over Indicia Indicia is een onafhankelijk tech, data en AI-bureau dat sinds 1996 organisaties helpt om digitaal te groeien. Vanuit de overtuiging dat succesvolle digitale oplossingen beginnen bij een goed begrip van de business, combineert Indicia technologie, data en ondernemerschap om organisaties verder te brengen. Met ruim 250 digitale specialisten biedt Indicia een breed scala aan diensten, waaronder online marketing, webdevelopment, HubSpot, AI en design. Van het ontwikkelen van websites en digitale platforms tot het realiseren van effectieve marketingcampagnes en slimme automatiseringen. Indicia bedient klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren en richt zich steeds meer op grotere organisaties en langdurige samenwerkingen. De organisatie bevindt zich in een fase van verdere professionalisering, waarbij de focus ligt op het verdiepen van specialismen, het versterken van de strategische klantrelaties en het realiseren van meetbare resultaten. AI speelt hierin een belangrijke rol. Indicia ontwikkelt eigen AI-tools om processen slimmer en efficiënter in te richten, waardoor meer ruimte ontstaat voor strategisch advies, innovatie en klantontwikkeling. De bedrijfscultuur is informeel, familiair en ondernemend. Collega's werken nauw samen, krijgen veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en worden gestimuleerd om zich zowel persoonlijk als professioneel te ontwikkelen. Tegelijkertijd groeit de ambitie om resultaatgerichter te werken en als organisatie verder te professionaliseren. https://www.indicia.ai/ Jouw verantwoordelijkheden: Ontwikkelen en presenteren van socialmediastrategieën voor grote klanten, waarbij je commerciële doelstellingen vertaalt naar concrete campagnes en meetbare resultaten; Actief bijdragen aan commerciële voorstellen, pitches en pre-salesgesprekken, waarbij je klanten adviseert over de mogelijkheden van social advertising; Fungeren als strategisch en inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor klanten, waarbij je periodiek campagneresultaten presenteert en proactief kansen voor upsell en cross-sell signaleert; Zelfstandig opzetten, beheren en optimaliseren van paid social campagnes op platforms als Meta, LinkedIn en TikTok, inclusief het bewaken van instellingen, KPI's en budgetten; Analyseren van campagneresultaten, uitvoeren van A/B-testen en continu verbeteren van performance, conversies en rendement; Samenwerken met het interne AI-lab om AI en automatisering slim toe te passen binnen campagnes, contentcreatie, budgetoptimalisatie en werkprocessen; Signaleren en toepassen van nieuwe ontwikkelingen binnen social advertising en AI, waarbij je ook de verbinding legt met andere online marketingdisciplines, zoals SEO en SEA; Coachen en begeleiden van junior social marketeers, kennis delen en bijdragen aan hun professionele ontwikkeling; Aanbrengen van structuur, stimuleren van eigenaarschap en bewaken van de kwaliteit binnen het social team. Jouw plek binnen de organisatie: Als ervaren collega ben je een vraagbaak en sparringpartner voor de junior social marketeers. Je deelt je kennis over social en AI, en helpt hen zo verder te groeien. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan Sophie Mees, Delivery Manager Online Marketing. Requirements Je bent een enthousiaste en ondernemende persoonlijkheid die energie brengt, initiatief neemt en het team weet mee te nemen in nieuwe ideeën. Je voelt je thuis in een informele en familiaire werkomgeving en draagt met jouw commerciële drive en resultaatgerichte instelling bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het team. Jouw impact als Senior Social & AI Marketeer

Als Senior Social & AI Marketeer bij Indicia ben je het strategische aanspreekpunt voor grote klanten en vertaal je hun commerciële doelstellingen naar effectieve socialmediastrategieën. Je combineert strategisch advies met een hands-on aanpak en ontwikkelt en optimaliseert campagnes op platforms als Meta, LinkedIn en TikTok. Daarbij werk je met grote mediabudgetten en krijg je volop ruimte om impact te maken. AI speelt een belangrijke rol in jouw werk. Je benut slimme tools en automatisering om campagnes, content en processen continu te verbeteren. Daarnaast signaleer je proactief commerciële kansen bij klanten en deel je jouw kennis en ervaring met junior marketeers. Zo draag je niet alleen bij aan het succes van klanten, maar ook aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het team en de dienstverlening van Indicia.

Over Indicia

Indicia is een onafhankelijk tech, data en AI-bureau dat sinds 1996 organisaties helpt om digitaal te groeien. Vanuit de overtuiging dat succesvolle digitale oplossingen beginnen bij een goed begrip van de business, combineert Indicia technologie, data en ondernemerschap om organisaties verder te brengen.

Met ruim 250 digitale specialisten biedt Indicia een breed scala aan diensten, waaronder online marketing, webdevelopment, HubSpot, AI en design. Van het ontwikkelen van websites en digitale platforms tot het realiseren van effectieve marketingcampagnes en slimme automatiseringen. Indicia bedient klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren en richt zich steeds meer op grotere organisaties en langdurige samenwerkingen.

De organisatie bevindt zich in een fase van verdere professionalisering, waarbij de focus ligt op het verdiepen van specialismen, het versterken van de strategische klantrelaties en het realiseren van meetbare resultaten. AI speelt hierin een belangrijke rol. Indicia ontwikkelt eigen AI-tools om processen slimmer en efficiënter in te richten, waardoor meer ruimte ontstaat voor strategisch advies, innovatie en klantontwikkeling.

De bedrijfscultuur is informeel, familiair en ondernemend. Collega's werken nauw samen, krijgen veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en worden gestimuleerd om zich zowel persoonlijk als professioneel te ontwikkelen. Tegelijkertijd groeit de ambitie om resultaatgerichter te werken en als organisatie verder te professionaliseren.

https://www.indicia.ai/

  • Samenwerken met het interne AI-lab om AI en automatisering slim toe te passen binnen campagnes, contentcreatie, budgetoptimalisatie en werkprocessen;

  • Coachen en begeleiden van junior social marketeers, kennis delen en bijdragen aan hun professionele ontwikkeling;

Als ervaren collega ben je een vraagbaak en sparringpartner voor de junior social marketeers. Je deelt je kennis over social en AI, en helpt hen zo verder te groeien. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan Sophie Mees, Delivery Manager Online Marketing.

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Our Purpose<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.</p> <h3>About Us<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.</p> <p>Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.</p> <h3><strong>What Are We Looking For?</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.</p></div><p>As a Senior Sales Operations Manager, you will support the EMEA South Go-To-Market team as a trusted advisor to sales leaders, enabling consistent, predictable, and repeatable hyper-growth through sales discipline, streamlined processes, and a strong operating cadence. You will partner with the EMEA South Leadership Team on GTM design, business analysis, and metrics while managing the day-to-day rhythm of the business, with field productivity as your north star. This role is based in Amsterdam, Prague, or Milan, and is ideal for someone who wants to be an active voice driving change rather than a passive spectator.</p> <h3>What Will You Do?</h3> <p>Primary responsibilities include:</p> <ul> <li>Serve as the EMEA South Operations Lead and trusted advisor to key sales leaders, actively participating in the EMEA forecasting process, advising on changing pipeline dynamics, and challenging forecasts to ensure accuracy, predictability, and transparency.</li> <li>Manage Area business metrics including performance, trends, headcount, and investment models, and lead the development of key sales metrics and business review materials, monitoring performance and taking action to optimize business results.</li> <li>Drive the annual sales planning process, including Area, Regional, and District goal assignments, territory management updates, and sales compensation plan changes.</li> <li>Identify gaps in the infrastructure needed to support Sales and develop solutions, with a strong focus on AI, that align to the team’s overall vision, while educating and training teams on key sales processes.</li> <li>Act as an active voice that drives change with Area leadership, and align with the Global Revenue Operations team to represent the needs of the field.</li> </ul> <h3>What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?</h3> <p>Ideal candidates will have:</p> <ul> <li>7 to 10 years of experience in Sales, Revenue, or Field Operations supporting sales teams, with a strong emphasis on enabling teams to be hyper-productive, ideally within organizations selling subscription security software.</li> <li>Experience designing and scaling processes that support a hyper-growth business model, including documenting key processes in a publicly traded environment.</li> <li>Proven analytical ability to turn disparate datasets into insightful analytics, including developing messaging, data visualizations, and executive-level presentations.</li> <li>Solid experience with a key tech stack including Salesforce, Clari, Tableau, MS Office, G-Suite, and AI tools.</li> <li>Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence sales teams, build collaborative relationships across functions, and translate the complex needs of the field. A Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Management, Technology, or Economics is required, and an MBA is a plus.</li> </ul> <h3>Why SentinelOne?</h3> <p>AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.</p> <p>We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:</p> <p><strong>Equity &amp; Rewards</strong></p> <ul> <li>Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)</li> <li>Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off &amp; Wellbeing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive leave benefits</li> <li>Gender-neutral parental leave</li> </ul> <p><strong>Insurance &amp; Financial Security</strong></p> <ul> <li>Insurance and medical allowance</li> <li>Pension scheme</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program (EAP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Work Perks &amp; Flexibility</strong></p> <ul> <li>Global home office allowance</li> <li>Mobile phone reimbursement</li> <li>Commuter or work-from-home allowance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wellness &amp; Lifestyle</strong></p> <ul> <li>Wellness benefit</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.&nbsp;</span></p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">To learn more about how we use AI in our hiring process, please review our&nbsp;<a href="https://assets.contentstack.io/v3/assets/blt53c99b43892c2378/bltca86b3b84e902400/AI-in-Hiring-SentinelOne.pdf">AI in Hiring Candidate Disclosure</a>.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

What You will Be Doing: Building Large-Scale Systems: Designing and engineering systems that can scale to handle high volumes of transactions. Developing Products Our Customers Love: Iterating from an idea to the final solution, shaping, building, testing, and measuring the performance of the features our customers love. Mentorship: Providing guidance and support to junior team members, fostering their growth through mentoring, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on collaboration. Regelmatig organiseren we gezellige teamuitjes, organiseren we uitdagende kennissessies en zijn we aanwezig op leerzame events! Als onderdeel van team Energie sta je midden in de energietransitie. Samen met je collega’s benader je deze enorme uitdaging procesmatig en vanuit de inhoud. Door een zeer professionele way of working kom je met elkaar tot creatieve en toekomstbestendige adviezen én ontwerpen die we aanbieden aan opdrachtgevers als TenneT, Stedin, ProRail, Provincies, Ministeries en Rijkswaterstaat. De afdeling Energie focust zich op duurzame energievoorziening, rail energiesystemen en EMC & netkwaliteit.

Movares is zeer ervaren en groot genoeg om succesvol te zijn in de meest uitdagende projecten van het land. Deze uitdagingen ga jij vanuit afdeling Energie aan binnen een informele organisatie met korte lijnen. Jij en je collega’s zijn zeer betrokken bij het werk. Samen met hen voer jij projecten uit in het werkveld Energie, voor ‘onze’ opdrachtgevers. Daarnaast werk je met teams van andere afdelingen samen aan multidisciplinaire projecten. Zo proef je verschillende werkvelden en leer je van adviseurs en engineers in meerdere disciplines. Jouw ontwikkeling gaat altijd door!

title: Interim Senior Community Manager
description: Who we are We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves.   With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another.   Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth.   We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands. We’re on the search for... Someone who has built a community for a brand before, and who can bring ours to life online and offline. Since 1959, Interrail has been more than a rail pass. We’re now building it into a cultural movement, and our community is where that movement becomes real: the deeper you travel through Europe, the more the journey changes you, told by the people who lived it. In 2027 our community moves into the Interrail app and website. Our product and technical team builds the platform. You make it a community: you shape the community vision, bring the first members in, and create the moments, online and in real life, that make travellers come back and help each other. The Brand team shapes what Interrail stands for and how it shows up wherever travellers meet us. We own our brand platform and positioning, and our community, bringing The Interrail Effect to life through the people who’ve travelled with us. We work closely with Product, Social & Community, Creative & Content, CRM, and the PR & Partnerships teams to keep every touchpoint consistent and culturally sharp. This is a nine-month interim contract. The team meets in the office a minimum of twice per week, so you’ll be required to join those days to work alongside your colleagues.   What you’ll be doing You’ll be part of the Brand team, reporting to the Brand Lead who owns the Community Program. You’ll lead the community from launch to a community that’s live, safe, well populated and growing, online and offline. The community isn’t a loyalty scheme or a fan club. It’s where travellers tell the truth about their journeys, inspire others and help the next person go and experience it. You’ll work closely with Product (Social Connection and Loyalty team), Customer Experience, Legal and Privacy, PR & Partnerships, Social, and our Creator Partnerships and Creative colleagues. You’ll be: Shaping the community vision, values and member code with the Brand Lead, and laying the foundations for Interrail as a cultural movement, online and offline. Building the community strategy: who we bring in first, which journeys launch first and how the community grows after launch. Bringing our existing members across as founding voices, and working with Content and Marketing to onboard our Pioneers. Launching the first community rituals, and making the community a source of real traveller stories for the brand. Designing and running a first pilot of real-world moments, such as gatherings at stations or partner places, with PR & Partnerships and Social. Building good relationships with the independent Interrail communities on Facebook, Reddit and beyond. We partner with them; we never try to replace them. Keeping the community safe: setting guidelines, the moderation approach with Customer Experience, and working with Legal, Privacy, and Safety so nothing goes live until it’s signed off. Being the members’ voice in our Product team, measuring community health with Analytics and CRM, and creating a playbook so what you build lasts. What we’re looking for Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you. 8+ years building communities for brands, including at least one you grew from launch. Experience running community both online and in real life, such as events, meet-ups or ambassador programs. You have written a community vision or strategy and turned it into a plan that others follow. A track record of building early momentum, so people join and champion the community, not just follow it. Experience setting moderation and safety policies, and comfort working with Legal and Privacy on consent, safeguarding and GDPR. A clear point of view on what makes a community healthy, and the confidence to defend it with product teams. Organised, good at documenting and comfortable working across many teams, so what you build outlasts your contract. A genuine interest in train travel, meeting locals, new experiences and other cultures. Bonus points for experience with community platforms or social SDKs, multilingual moderation, or a long rail trip through Europe of your own.    Curious to apply? Apply directly through our careers page .   We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through. For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice.   If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you.   To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. raw.title: Interim Senior Community Manager
raw.description:
Who we are

We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves.

 

With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another.

 

Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth.

 

We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands.

We’re on the search for...

Someone who has built a community for a brand before, and who can bring ours to life online and offline. Since 1959, Interrail has been more than a rail pass. We’re now building it into a cultural movement, and our community is where that movement becomes real: the deeper you travel through Europe, the more the journey changes you, told by the people who lived it.

In 2027 our community moves into the Interrail app and website. Our product and technical team builds the platform. You make it a community: you shape the community vision, bring the first members in, and create the moments, online and in real life, that make travellers come back and help each other.

The Brand team shapes what Interrail stands for and how it shows up wherever travellers meet us. We own our brand platform and positioning, and our community, bringing The Interrail Effect to life through the people who’ve travelled with us. We work closely with Product, Social & Community, Creative & Content, CRM, and the PR & Partnerships teams to keep every touchpoint consistent and culturally sharp.

This is a nine-month interim contract. The team meets in the office a minimum of twice per week, so you’ll be required to join those days to work alongside your colleagues.

 

What you’ll be doing

You’ll be part of the Brand team, reporting to the Brand Lead who owns the Community Program. You’ll lead the community from launch to a community that’s live, safe, well populated and growing, online and offline.

The community isn’t a loyalty scheme or a fan club. It’s where travellers tell the truth about their journeys, inspire others and help the next person go and experience it. You’ll work closely with Product (Social Connection and Loyalty team), Customer Experience, Legal and Privacy, PR & Partnerships, Social, and our Creator Partnerships and Creative colleagues.

You’ll be:

  • Shaping the community vision, values and member code with the Brand Lead, and laying the foundations for Interrail as a cultural movement, online and offline.

  • Building the community strategy: who we bring in first, which journeys launch first and how the community grows after launch.

  • Bringing our existing members across as founding voices, and working with Content and Marketing to onboard our Pioneers.

  • Launching the first community rituals, and making the community a source of real traveller stories for the brand.

  • Designing and running a first pilot of real-world moments, such as gatherings at stations or partner places, with PR & Partnerships and Social.

  • Building good relationships with the independent Interrail communities on Facebook, Reddit and beyond. We partner with them; we never try to replace them.

  • Keeping the community safe: setting guidelines, the moderation approach with Customer Experience, and working with Legal, Privacy, and Safety so nothing goes live until it’s signed off.

  • Being the members’ voice in our Product team, measuring community health with Analytics and CRM, and creating a playbook so what you build lasts.

What we’re looking for

Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you.

  • 8+ years building communities for brands, including at least one you grew from launch.

  • Experience running community both online and in real life, such as events, meet-ups or ambassador programs.

  • You have written a community vision or strategy and turned it into a plan that others follow.

  • A track record of building early momentum, so people join and champion the community, not just follow it.

  • Experience setting moderation and safety policies, and comfort working with Legal and Privacy on consent, safeguarding and GDPR.

  • A clear point of view on what makes a community healthy, and the confidence to defend it with product teams.

  • Organised, good at documenting and comfortable working across many teams, so what you build outlasts your contract.

  • A genuine interest in train travel, meeting locals, new experiences and other cultures.

Bonus points for experience with community platforms or social SDKs, multilingual moderation, or a long rail trip through Europe of your own.

  

Curious to apply?

Apply directly through our careers page.

 

  • We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through.

  • For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice.

 

If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you.

 

To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential.

 

In the meantime

If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values?

 

Got questions? Our team would be happy to help: just drop us a note at

 

While you’re here, you can plan your own trip and find your Pass at www.interrail.com.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Customs
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport:&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.&nbsp;</p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h3><strong>Why Customs Matters More Than Ever</strong></h3> <p>International trade is under more pressure than ever before. With tariffs, shifting regulations, and geopolitical uncertainty, customs has gone from a back-office function to a boardroom priority. The recent trade crisis—sparked by Trump-era tariffs—has made customs the single most complex challenge for global businesses. For many, it’s the difference between keeping supply chains moving or grinding them to a halt.</p> <p>That’s where we come in. The <strong>Customs Technology team</strong> at Flexport is leading the charge. We are building the systems that help entrepreneurs and global brands navigate complexity, stay compliant, and keep the world’s goods flowing.</p> <h2>The opportunity:&nbsp;</h2> <p>Customs brokerage is one of the largest, most under-innovated opportunities in logistics. Legacy customs brokers are stuck with outdated systems and manual processes—they simply can’t adapt fast enough.</p> <p>Flexport is growing fast because we’re different. We are the only big tech company in the space, and the only freight forwarder that got founded after the launch of Netscape. Being a tech company, we can move much faster than our competitors, and give our customers the service they expect in this day and age. We can deploy things like LLM agents at scale, in an industry that is ripe to be disrupted by this technology.</p> <p><strong>Things we ❤️</strong></p> <ul> <li>Leveraging AI in a safe way to eliminate mundane work for customs brokers and automate customs every step of the way</li> <li>Modeling complex and ambiguous domains into fully automated workflows</li> <li>Building highly performant and reliable Kotlin services on our cutting-edge infrastructure platform</li> <li>Collaborating with end users across the globe to create the best possible product: removing toil and surfacing interesting cases</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You will:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Work closely with business partners and product managers to distill complex business problems into elegant technical solutions.</li> <li>Work on systems that represent the real-world intricacies of logistics entities and the process of moving cargo in and out of countries.</li> <li>Build and launch products rapidly and incrementally. We ship to production dozens of times per day.</li> <li>Geek out about shipping, customs regulations and logistics. (We do this often.)</li> <li>Figure out the most efficient way for our customers and partners to participate in the process of moving freight across borders.</li> <li>Design and build deep, complex integrations with government agencies and partners.</li> <li>Automate archaic customs filing processes and save the operations team thousands of phone calls per week.</li> <li>Deliver supply chain insights to logistics teams via a world-class analytics experience.</li> <li>Create beautiful and efficient domain models for the incredibly complex world of freight forwarding.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You should have:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>≥ 5 years of experience writing software, and a strong engineering background.</li> <li>A love of simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break.</li> <li>The ability to convey technical ideas in common terms to business partners, product managers, designers and engineers alike.</li> <li>A bias for action. When you see a problem, you solve it.</li> <li>A desire to develop your tooling repertoire. Our Tech Stack

At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes. Our Architecture is a distributed architecture made of several "Modular Monoliths". We practise DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Domain Driven Design, and Contract Driven Development.

 

Your role

In your daily role, your impact will be defined by key pillars: Delivery, Direction, Talent, and Culture.

  • Delivery: Lead your team to scope and plan projects, identifying bottlenecks and improving processes. You will ensure engineering standards are held high and remove impediments to provide a smooth developer experience. 
  • Direction: Create alignment and a sense of urgency through well-crafted strategies and goals. You will direct your team to relate their work to organizational goals and provide a clear sense of purpose.
  • Talent: Nurture talent with regular feedback and performance reviews, supporting career growth. You will identify skill gaps and execute hiring strategies to acquire top talent.
  • Culture: Lead by example to foster ownership, empowerment, and autonomy. You will promote a growth mindset, value diverse perspectives, and address problems to maintain a healthy team culture.
  • Craft: Equip your team to solve problems with pragmatic, sustainable solutions. You will foster engineering excellence, support knowledge-sharing, and keep the team up to date with the latest technical trends.
  • AI-first engineering: Make AI a core part of how your team works, not an experiment on the side. You will drive adoption of AI-assisted development and review, define what good practice looks like, and measure the effect on delivery speed and quality. You will keep the team's standards high while the way of working changes.

Join Fastned at the forefront of Europe’s electric vehicle and charging infrastructure revolution! We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Working Student with a strong passion for data, analytics and procurement . In this role, you will play a key part and help build the foundations of Procurement at Fastned.

Procurement at Fastned is designed to support the business, not constrain it. The Procurement function does not make unilateral decisions about supplier or product selection. Instead, it brings structure, market insight, commercial expertise and oversight. You will help put this approach into practice.

What you’ll be doing

  • Dive into our supplier and purchasing data to uncover spending patterns, spot smart consolidation opportunities, and identify potential savings.

  • Support our Procurement Champions across different teams by sharing handy tools, templates, and everyday guidance.

  • Coordinate meetings and workshops with internal teams and suppliers, making sure decisions and follow-up actions are clearly captured.

  • You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s programme (ideally in Business, Economics, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field) with a genuine interest in procurement, supplier management, or commercial negotiations.

  • Fluency in English is essential, and any additional European language is a bonus.

  • You’re excited about Fastned’s mission and eager to play an active part in accelerating the energy transition.

  • Procurement category management and strategic sourcing

  • Supplier and contract management

  • Spend analysis, RFP and tender processes

  • Commercial negotiations

  • Procurement governance and stakeholder management

  • Building a new Procurement function in a fast-growing international company

description: <p>Build and own a self-service, multi-tenant platform that keeps the critical data of 20+ customers recoverable<br><br>Do you like building platforms that other teams consume, at scale, across private and public clouds, with security and tenant isolation as non-negotiables? At Schuberg Philis, the world is shifting from traditional backup to data security and resilience. We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to strengthen our Data Management-as-a-Service (DMS) team and help us build the next generation of our platform.<br><br>About the Team<br><br>The DMS team builds and runs a shared, fully segregated data resilience platform that serves more than 20 of our customers. Customer teams consume it through self-service, and they handle their own day-to-day backup and restore operations. That means you won’t spend your days on job monitoring, restore tickets or backup schedules. Your customers are internal and external engineering teams, and your product is the platform they build on.<br><br>You’ll join a dedicated group of data security experts within our larger Services Team and work closely with our sbp.cloud team, who operate our self-built sovereign cloud solutions. With our plan-build-run approach, you take end-to-end ownership: you design it, you build it, you run it.<br><br>The Challenge<br><br>Running one platform for 20+ customers means solving the hard problems of platform engineering:</p> <ul> <li>Multi-tenancy by design: strict isolation of data, access, and performance between customers, on shared infrastructure.</li> <li>Self-service at scale: APIs, guardrails and automation that let customer teams onboard and operate independently, without tickets.</li> <li>Scale and resilience: 4,000+ protected endpoints and more than 25,000 recovery points generated daily, on a dedicated private cloud spanning multiple availability zones.</li> <li>Heterogeneous workloads: Oracle, MS-SQL, SAP, Sybase, PaaS, container platforms and VMs across VMware VCF, OpenStack, AWS, Azure and Kubernetes.</li> <li>Modern storage back-ends: public cloud services and S3-compatible object storage built on Pure FlashBlade//S and NetApp StorageGRID in our own datacenters, plus a long-term archiving tier.</li> <li>Security first: immutability, segregation and hardening in a highly secure environment where recoverability is the ultimate guarantee.</li> </ul> <p>Your Role<br><br>As a Platform Engineer, you take full responsibility for the lifecycle of the platform: architecture, deployment, evolution and reliability. You treat the platform as a product: you improve features, drive innovation and keep the user experience of customer teams in mind. You work closely with technology vendors (primarily Commvault) and push their product teams to improve, while applying standardized guardrails, driving automation and following best-in-class practices.<br><br>Your focus is on making day-2 operations simple and cost-effective, so there is room to implement new security features, streamline customer onboarding and enable new projects. You also guide customers in their data protection needs, contribute to RFIs/RFPs, and help scope and design new solutions.<br><br>What You’ll Do</p> <ul> <li>Own the architecture and lifecycle of a multi-tenant data resilience platform, in line with our plan-build-run methodology.</li> <li>Design and ship self-service capabilities that customer teams use independently, end to end.</li> <li>Automate everything repeatable: deployments, tenant onboarding, configuration and platform operations, using Infrastructure as Code.</li> <li>Ensure platform availability, aiming for 100% uptime and maximum customer satisfaction.</li> <li>Evolve a diverse storage back-end across public cloud and on-prem S3-compatible solutions.</li> <li>Enable customers to protect workloads on VMware VCF, OpenStack, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes and more.</li> <li>Work with vendor product teams and drive their roadmaps.</li> <li>Provide hands-on advisory and technical support, contribute to RFI/RFP processes, and help design new solutions.</li> </ul> <p>Who Are You?</p> <ul> <li>First and foremost, you are a platform engineer at heart, and you like building things other engineers rely on. A passion for data protection, security and resilience is a plus, and you’ll grow it here.</li> <li>You enjoy teamwork, thrive on challenges and like collaborating with both peers and customers.</li> <li>You’re comfortable in highly secure, complex environments.</li> <li>You have a solid understanding of multi-tenant architectures and security concepts.</li> <li>You are proficient in Linux and/or Windows ecosystems.</li> <li>You have experience across private (VMware/OpenStack) and public cloud platforms (Azure, AWS).</li> <li>You’re skilled in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible and/or Chef) and in scripting and automation (Python, Bash, PowerShell, etc.).</li> <li>Experience with data management/protection tools is valuable, whether Commvault, Rubrik or similar, but not a must. We’ll teach you the domain; you bring the engineering craft.</li> </ul> <p>More information?<br><br>Do not hesitate to call Maggie: 06 23 75 70 86.</p> <p><em>Only application submitted through the website will be considered.&nbsp;</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>Everyone we work with and consider working with has a right to equal treatment.
